jobs.title: Project Coordinator / Office Assistant
jobs.description:
**The Role**

This is a combined project coordination and office operations role. Roughly two\-thirds of your week is keeping retailer and brand projects moving — deadlines, documents, follow\-ups — and the remaining third is keeping the office and its records running cleanly. It suits someone organized and self\-directed who wants range rather than a narrow lane.

**Project Coordination**

* Track retailer launch timelines end to end — item setup, purchase orders, shipping windows, in\-store dates — and flag slipping dates before they become problems.
* Prepare and maintain project documents: purchase orders, line sheets, item setup forms, vendor and new\-item forms, packing and compliance paperwork.
* Coordinate between U.S. retail partners, our Korea\-based brand partners and internal logistics, following up until items actually close.
* Maintain project trackers and shared files so the team and outside partners are working from one current version.
* Schedule and prepare meetings across U.S. and Korea time zones; circulate agendas, notes and action items.
* Support sample requests and shipments to buyers, showrooms and trade events, including tracking and confirmation.

**Office \& Administrative Operations**

* Manage the shared company inbox and phone line, routing and responding as the first point of contact.
* Maintain organized digital filing for contracts, certificates, invoices and vendor records.
* Handle office supplies, shipping supplies, equipment and vendor accounts.
* Assist with expense records, invoices and basic bookkeeping handoffs to accounting.
* Support onboarding logistics for new team members and visiting partners, including travel and meeting arrangements.
* Assist the Managing Director with scheduling, correspondence and ad hoc business needs.

**What We're Looking For**

**Required**

* 2\+ years in project coordination, office management, executive assistance or operations — ideally at a small company where you wore several hats.
* Strong written and verbal English; clear, professional communication with outside partners.
* Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets, and comfort with document and file management tools.
* Proven ability to juggle multiple deadlines and follow up without being chased.
* Accuracy with detail — purchase orders, item data and compliance forms have to be right the first time.
* Authorized to work in the United States; able to work on\-site.

**Preferred**

* Korean / English bilingual — a significant advantage, as much of our brand\-side communication is with partners in Korea.
* Experience in consumer goods, beauty, retail, distribution or import / export.
* Familiarity with retailer vendor portals or EDI (Target POL, SPS Commerce, STIBO or similar).
* Experience with purchase orders, inventory or logistics documentation.
* Experience coordinating with third\-party logistics (3PL) and using order management (OMS) or warehouse management (WMS) systems.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

**Pay range: ($60,000 – $65,000 annualized), non\-exempt and overtime eligible.**

Final compensation depends on experience, bilingual ability and demonstrated scope of prior responsibility. The range reflects current Los Angeles market pay for combined project coordination and office operations roles.

* Paid time off and standard U.S. holidays
* Health benefits per company plan
* Direct exposure to national retail accounts and senior decision\-making at a growing company
* Growth path toward a dedicated project or account management role as the business scales

Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $60,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90021

jobs.title: Domestic Violence Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:

United American Indian Involvement (UAII) is the only Native American led non\-profit organization in Los Angeles County, proudly serving as a home for American Indian and Alaska Native communities. Through our healthcare facility and culturally centered programs, we provide essential physical, behavioral, and spiritual health services—helping individuals stay connected to their Tribal heritage and traditions.


For over 50 years, UAII has grown to become the largest nonprofit provider of health and human services for American Indians and Alaska Natives in Los Angeles, home to the nation’s largest Urban Indian population. Our dedicated team delivers compassionate care that supports daily healing, resilience, and the continued strength of our communities. UAII is committed to uphold Indigenous values in all aspects of our work. It guides our actions, relationships, and responsibilities, ensuring that we serve our communities with integrity, respect, and accountability.

**Core Principles**

* Respect for Relatives – I will honor the dignity of all people, recognizing that every individual is a relative deserving of respect, compassion, and care.
* Community Responsibility – My work is not only for individual benefit but for the collective well\-being of our communities, present and future.
* Cultural Integrity \- I will safeguard and uplift Indigenous languages, traditions, and cultural practices, ensuring they remain central to our organizational life.
* Reciprocity \- We give back in balance with what we receive, fostering mutual trust and accountability in all relationships.
* Stewardship – I will act as a caretaker of our communities, resources, and environment, mindful of the impact of our decisions on future generations.
* Truth and Transparency – I will communicate honestly and openly, ensuring clarity in our commitments and accountability in our actions

**The Domestic Violence Program Coordinator is a grant funded position.**

  



**Position Summary**


The Domestic Violence Program Coordinator is responsible for the development, coordination, and implementation of culturally responsive domestic violence prevention, advocacy, outreach, education, and training services for American Indian and Alaska Native individuals and families. This position provides trauma\-informed support, facilitates community engagement and awareness activities, conducts trainings and educational presentations, and collaborates with Tribal representatives, child welfare agencies, courts, and community partners to promote survivor safety, family stability, and positive outcomes for Native families. The Domestic Violence Program Coordinator supports compliance with the Indian Child Welfare Act (ICWA), attends dependency and related court hearings, assists with resource navigation and referrals, maintains program documentation and reporting requirements, and represents UAII in community meetings, coalitions, and outreach events while upholding the organization's mission, values, and commitment to preserving and strengthening Native families and communities.


Requirements:
* Provide peer support and mentorship to families involved in Indian Child Welfare cases and case involving domestic violence and/or sexual assault.
* Assist clients in understanding and navigating the Department of Social Services, court system, and domestic violence/sexual assault proceedings.
* Advocate for the best interests of domestic violence and sexual assault survivors.
* Provide support services within UAII or provide referrals as needed for domestic violence/sexual assault offenders.
* Work collaboratively with Child and Family Services staff, tribal representatives, and community partners to support client safety, family preservation, and cultural connections.
* Facilitate access to resources, services, and educational opportunities tailored to the unique needs of Native individuals and families.
* Document case activities and maintain clear, accurate records in accordance with organizational policies.
* Serve as the intake and referral specialist for new clients seeking DV/SA support.
* Coordinate and manage referrals to DV/SA support services and the Healthcare Division, ensuring clients remain connected to resources that support their wellness goals.
* Answer and triage incoming calls across the organization, directing individuals to the appropriate programs and staff.
* Attend court hearings as the designated representative for UAII, ensuring the organization’s interests and documentation are accurately presented.
* Coordinate domestic violence prevention and advocacy activities.
* Conduct community outreach, engagement, and awareness events.
* Develop and facilitate training and workshops.
* Attend court hearings related to ICWA and domestic violence/sexual assault matters.
* Collaborate with Tribal representatives, DCFS, attorneys, courts, and community partners.
* Assist with safety planning, referrals, and client advocacy.
* Maintain accurate documentation, reports, and program records.
* Participate in community coalitions and multidisciplinary meetings.
* Prepare reports and support grant requirements.
* Must be able to reliably travel between our Los Angeles office and assigned court hearings.
* Must be able to occasionally work evenings, and weekends as needed for Company events.
* Strong communication skills and ability to provide empathetic, culturally informed support to peers.
* Commitment to upholding the values and traditions of Native communities.
* Commitment to upholding the Mission and Vision of United American Indian Involvement.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications and Skills**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Associate degree in social work, Human Services, Child Development, or a related field; or a comparable combination of education, professional experience, and/or relevant lived experience supporting domestic violence, sexual assault survivors.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Circadia Health**



Circadia Health is a growth\-stage healthcare AI company on a mission to prevent avoidable hospitalizations and transform senior\-care operations. Our Circadia Intelligence Platform combines:


* Contactless sensing that monitors respiration and motion with medical\-grade accuracy
* Native predictive models that detect 85% of preventable adverse events several days in advance
* Enterprise integrations that operationalize predictions directly inside EHR, care\-coordination, billing, and compliance workflows

Today, our technology touches 40,000\+ post\-acute patients daily across skilled\-nursing, home\-health, and home\-care networks. We are backed by leading healthcare and AI investors and headquartered in El Segundo, CA.

**What You'll Do**
------------------


**Implementation and Support**


* Lead on\-site implementation of Circadia's monitoring platform in SNFs, from device installation through go\-live, integrating it into existing care routines rather than adding a parallel process.
* Assess each facility before rollout: shift patterns, unit layout, staffing model, EHR workflow, and connectivity constraints.
* Build and execute the facility implementation plan with clear owners, dates, and dependencies, keeping it current as conditions change.
* Serve as first\-line support after launch: troubleshoot devices and connectivity, resolve staff questions, and escalate product issues with enough detail for Engineering to act.
* Track device uptime and utilization by facility, unit, and shift, and flag gaps before the customer does.


**Training and Adoption**


* Deliver training to clinical and frontline staff across all shifts, including nights and weekends, where adoption gaps usually live.
* Tailor content and delivery to the audience. CNAs, nurses, DONs, unit managers, and facility IT each need a different version.
* Build and maintain training materials and a knowledge base that hold up after you leave the building.
* Identify the behavioral reason adoption is lagging rather than defaulting to another session, and retrain where retraining is the actual fix.
* Develop facility champions and super\-users so competence survives staff turnover.


**Relationship Management and Collaboration**


* Build working trust with facility teams at every level, from the floor to the administrator, so staff surface issues early.
* Coordinate with in\-house care teams and remote clinical providers so the customer experiences one program, not several.
* Participate in interdisciplinary team meetings, contributing implementation insight and ensuring device data is used inside patient care plans.
* Partner with Customer Success, Clinical, Support, and Engineering to unblock deployments, and own customer\-facing communication while a dependency is open.
* Hand off to Customer Success with a documented account state: utilization baseline, stakeholder map, and open risks.


**Quality Improvement and Compliance**


* Feed field evidence to Product and Engineering: failure modes, workflow friction, and what staff actually do with the product.
* Ensure all activity complies with regulatory standards and patient safety guidelines.
* Maintain accurate documentation of implementation activity, staff education, and device functionality checks, aligned to organizational and regulatory requirements.
* Follow facility protocols on HIPAA, infection control, and site access.

**Qualifications**
------------------



**Must\-have**


* Bachelor's degree in business, operations, healthcare administration, nursing, or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience in a healthcare setting.
* Comfort operating inside healthcare environments, particularly skilled nursing facilities, with working knowledge of nursing workflows, shift structure, and floor dynamics.
* Clear, confident verbal and written communication with the ability to train and hold a room of clinical staff.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build credibility quickly with audiences ranging from CNAs to facility administrators.
* Practical problem\-solving: you diagnose the cause on site rather than escalating it as\-is.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, managing your own schedule, follow\-up, and commitments across multiple facilities at once.
* Organizational rigor with project tracking tools such as Monday.com. Nothing lives only in your head.
* Willingness to travel up to 75%, including early mornings and occasional overnight shift coverage.


**Preferred**


* Experience implementing healthcare technology, remote patient monitoring, or telehealth services in provider settings.
* Clinical background or license (RN, LPN, RT, CNA) or direct post\-acute operations experience.
* Experience training frontline staff in high\-turnover environments.


As a full\-time **Implementation Specialist,** you will be employed by Circadia Health, Inc. The anticipated annual base salary range for this full\-time position is $75,000 \- $100,000\. The base range is determined by role and level, and placement within the range will depend on a number of job\-related factors, including but not limited to your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.



Annual salary is only one part of an employee's total compensation package at Circadia Health. We also offer:


* Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k)
* Competitive time off with pay policies including vacation, sick days, and company holidays
* Impact: your work will influence care decisions for tens of thousands of seniors every day.
* Culture: hard\-working, mission\-driven, and collaborative — with weekly and monthly social events like yoga, beach bonfires, and Wednesday/Friday team lunches.

**Ionblade — Entry\-Level Sales Development Representative (SDR)**

**Location**: 133 N. Altadena Drive, Pasadena, CA 91107

**Work arrangement**: Full\-time, in\-office at hire; hybrid work may be considered after one year based on sustained performance, reliability, business needs, and company policy

**Employment type**: Hourly, nonexempt, full\-time

**Schedule**: Monday–Friday; assigned schedule of either 6:00 AM–2:30 PM or 7:00 AM–3:30 PM, including a 30\-minute unpaid, off\-duty meal period

**Pay**: $28\.50 per hour, plus uncapped monthly new\-account commission

**Target commute area**: Candidates must currently live within 15 miles of 133 N. Altadena Drive, Pasadena, CA 91107, or be able to reliably commute to the office from within that distance by their start date.

**About Ionblade**

Ionblade provides web hosting business services supported by a consultative, high\-activity sales process. We are hiring two Entry\-Level Sales Development Representatives to help prospective customers understand and select qualifying Ionblade services.

This is an excellent starting sales role for a reliable, coachable, competitive person who communicates clearly, handles rejection professionally, and wants a real path into Account Executive or sales\-management responsibility. Prior sales experience and a college degree are not required. We will train the right person.

**The Role**

As an Entry\-Level SDR, you will work from Ionblade\-provided leads, make a high volume of outbound calls, qualify prospective customers, and close lower\-complexity opportunities. You will use 8x8, WHMCS, Google Workspace, and Ionblade sales processes to accurately record activity and move opportunities forward. Some larger or more complex opportunities will be passed to an Account Executive or manager. You may still receive account credit when you originated or qualified the opportunity, subject to CRM attribution and Ionblade’s commission policy. This is an in\-office role at the start. It is designed for someone who wants consistent coaching, structured training, clear expectations, and advancement based on results.

**What You’ll Do**

 Make approximately 200 outbound call attempts per business day, averaged across the workweek

 Build toward approximately 2–3 hours of valid customer conversation time per day; talk time is used as a coaching and reporting metric, not as a standalone hard quota

 Contact and follow up with Ionblade\-provided leads using professional, clear, customer\-focused communication

 Learn customer needs, qualify opportunities, and recommend appropriate lower\-complexity Ionblade services

 Close qualifying sales and help new customers complete payment and service activation

 Accurately document calls, customer needs, next steps, sales activity, lead ownership, and

outcomes in company systems

 Use 8x8, WHMCS, Google Workspace, and other Ionblade tools as assigned

 Route larger, technical, or complex sales opportunities to an Account Executive or manager while preserving accurate CRM attribution

 Participate in coaching, call reviews, role\-play, product training, and team meetings

 Maintain reliable attendance, punctuality, professional conduct, and consistent follow\-through

 Follow all company sales, privacy, data\-security, and customer\-communication procedures

**What Success Looks Like**

After the initial 30–60\-day ramp period, successful SDRs generally:

 Maintain consistent, well\-documented outbound activity

 Build productive customer conversation time and high\-quality follow\-up habits

 Demonstrate strong call quality, reliability, CRM discipline, and coachability

 Work toward 20 or more credited new paying customer accounts per month

 Escalate the right opportunities while retaining accurate lead and account ownership records

 Treat prospects and customers professionally, even when a conversation does not lead to a sale

**Qualifications Required**

 Ability to work full\-time, in person, at Ionblade’s Pasadena office

 Current residence within 15 miles of 133 N. Altadena Drive, Pasadena, CA 91107, or ability to reliably commute from within that distance by the start date

 Strong verbal communication skills and clear professional writing

 Comfort making a high volume of outbound calls and hearing “no” without losing focus or professionalism

 Reliability, punctuality, resilience, competitiveness, and willingness to learn from coaching

 Basic comfort using browser\-based business software, email, calendars, and spreadsheets

 Ability to organize follow\-up tasks and keep accurate notes

 Authorization to work in the United States Preferred, Not Required

 Sales, customer service, call\-center, retail, appointment\-setting, hospitality, or service\-industry experience

 Familiarity with CRM, ticketing, VoIP, hosting, SaaS, IT, web, or technical\-service environments

 College coursework or degree No prior sales experience is required. We value potential, work ethic, communication, and coachability.

**Compensation**

Base Pay

 $28\.50 per hour

 Full\-time, nonexempt position

 40 paid working hours per week, excluding the 30\-minute unpaid meal period each workday

 Overtime eligibility and payment in accordance with applicable law

 Approximate annual base pay at 40 hours per week: $59,280 before overtime and commissions

**Monthly New\-Account Commission**

After successful completion of the four\-week training period, SDRs may earn uncapped monthly commission for credited new paying customer accounts:

Credited new accounts in a calendar month Commission rate

0–19 No new\-account commission

20–29 $35 for each credited new account that month

30 or more $40 for each credited new account that month

A credited new account is a new customer account for a qualifying Ionblade service for which payment has successfully cleared and the service has activated.

An SDR may receive account credit when they originated or qualified

jobs.title: Social Media Content & Community Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Concert Cruise Events

Concert Cruise Events creates large\-scale, music\-driven cruise experiences across multiple brands, including Super Legends Cruise, Old School Cruise, Cali Country Cruise, and Latin Legends Cruise. Our social media channels are a major part of how guests discover our events, learn to trust our brands, get excited about upcoming cruises, and stay connected to our community.

The Role

We are looking for a creative, highly engaged Social Media Content \& Community Coordinator who can help turn our social media pages into destinations our guests and music fans want to visit every day. The primary focus is creating, finding, scheduling, and publishing engaging content while actively managing our online communities. This is not primarily a customer\-service or comment\-response position.

You should constantly be asking: “What can we post today that our guests and music fans will find interesting, useful, exciting, or worth sharing?”

Content may include artist news, birthdays, new music releases, throwback performances, cruise memories, videos, polls, event announcements, theme nights, travel information, registration reminders, behind\-the\-scenes content, artist spotlights, countdowns, carousels, and other creative ideas.

Our Social Communities

Public Event \& Brand Pages

These pages introduce people to our events and showcase the excitement, credibility, artists, guests, and experiences behind each cruise. Content should attract new followers while keeping existing fans engaged and excited about our brands.

Guest Cruise Groups

These communities are primarily for guests preparing to sail. Content should keep guests informed and excited with important deadlines, travel information, theme nights, registration instructions, entertainment updates, things to know before sailing, and other useful cruise information.

*Understanding the difference between these audiences \- and creating appropriate content for each \- is a major part of the position.*

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain an active content calendar across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and our different event communities.• Research and identify fresh, relevant content involving our artists, music genres, events, and guest interests.• Write engaging social copy that is natural, exciting, accurate, and consistent with each brand.• Create and schedule posts, carousels, photos, videos, polls, announcements, and other engaging content.• Keep public event pages active and interesting even when we are not making major company announcements.• Keep sailing guests informed about deadlines, registration, theme nights, travel requirements, special events, schedule information, and other important cruise updates.• Work closely with our email content/marketing team so important guest communications are coordinated across email and social media.• Use Meta Business Suite, Hootsuite, or similar platforms to efficiently manage multiple brands, pages, groups, comments, and messages.• Monitor Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and other channels for important conversations, trends, complaints, misinformation, or developing issues.• Engage with our communities and help maintain a positive, active environment.• Use our chatbot and approved information resources to help answer appropriate guest questions.• Coordinate with team members who handle routine questions and responses rather than personally answering every basic inquiry.• Identify sales opportunities and route them to the appropriate sales team member.• Escalate customer\-service issues, complaints, payment questions, booking problems, or other situations to the appropriate department.• Recognize issues developing within a community and alert management quickly when something requires attention.• Track engagement and identify what types of content perform well so we can continuously improve our social strategy.

What We’re Looking For

* Strong social media content creation experience \- not simply customer service experience.• Excellent writing skills and the ability to create engaging, conversational social content.• Hands\-on experience managing Facebook and Instagram pages and groups; TikTok experience is strongly preferred.• Working knowledge of Meta Business Suite, Hootsuite, or comparable social media management platforms.• Ability to manage multiple brands and communities without confusing messaging or audiences.• Strong creative instincts and the ability to continually find new content ideas without waiting to be assigned every post.• Comfort researching artists, music news, trends, anniversaries, releases, birthdays, and other relevant content opportunities.• Ability to create effective social posts and carousels and work with our creative team when graphics or video assets are needed.• Strong organizational skills and the ability to coordinate content with email, marketing, sales, guest services, and operations.• Good judgment about when to engage directly, when to use approved information, and when an issue needs to be escalated.• Experience in music, entertainment, events, travel, hospitality, or cruise\-related businesses is a plus.

The Person Who Will Succeed Here

We want someone who loves social media and naturally looks for reasons to post and engage. We want someone who comes to us with ideas \- not someone waiting for management to hand them every post.

The right person understands that social media is not simply a place to answer questions or post advertisements. It is where we build relationships with guests, showcase our events, celebrate the music and artists our guests love, provide important information, and create communities people want to be part of.

Schedule \& Benefits

This is a full\-time, in\-office position based in our Newport Beach office. Some cruises, launches, and events require scheduled evening, weekend, or travel work. Hours worked during those assignments are recorded and paid in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Executive Assistant  
**Department:** Executive  
**Reports To:** Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

**Reporting to this Position:** N/A  
**Location:** Office  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Classification:** Salary/Exempt

**ABOUT TILLY’S LIFE CENTER (TLC)**

Tilly's Life Center (TLC) is a transformative nonprofit at the forefront of addressing the urgent mental health crisis faced by today's young people. Through strategic partnerships with educational institutions and community\-based organizations, TLC offers its "I Am Me" curriculum, equipping adolescents and young adults with critical life skills to develop a healthy identity and positive mindset, manage emotions, achieve personal and academic goals, foster strong relationships, and make responsible decisions—ultimately setting them on a path toward lasting success and overall well\-being. With an annual budget of $2\.7 million, TLC continues to expand its reach and deepen its impact through these strategic collaborations.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Executive Assistant provides primary administrative support to the CEO. As a secondary responsibility, this position supports TLC’s operations through accounts payable, accounts receivable, and banking administration; human resources administration; and selected office duties. When those responsibilities allow, the position provides development data and administrative support. The role calls for sound judgment, accuracy, discretion, and the ability to manage shifting priorities.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

***Executive Support to the CEO***

* Manage the CEO’s calendar, scheduling, meeting preparation, travel arrangements, correspondence, and follow up on assigned priorities.
* Draft, edit, and organize CEO communications, reports, presentations, and confidential records.
* Coordinate Board of Directors and committee meeting logistics, including agendas, materials, minutes when assigned, and action item tracking.
* Serve as a responsive liaison between the CEO and staff, Board members, partners, and other stakeholders; keep organizational deadlines visible to the CEO.
* Track cross\-department projects and initiatives at the CEO’s direction, follow up with responsible staff, and report progress and outstanding decisions to the CEO.

**Operations Support**

***Accounts Payable, Receivable, and Banking***

* Receive and organize invoices, verify supporting documentation, code expenses according to TLC procedures, and route payments and reimbursements for approval.
* Prepare approved invoices, record incoming payments, monitor receivables, and follow up on outstanding balances in coordination with the fractional CFO.
* Prepare deposits and maintain banking and transaction records; coordinate routine bank inquiries and provide documentation for reconciliations and month\-end close.
* Track due dates and maintain accurate, confidential records for vendors, customers, payments, deposits, and restricted transactions as applicable.
* Follow TLC’s financial controls and approval limits; the position does not approve its own transactions or independently authorize payments.

***Human Resources Administration***

* Coordinate job postings, candidate scheduling and communications, onboarding and offboarding checklists, and required personnel paperwork.
* Maintain confidential employee files and track evaluation dates, policy acknowledgments, training records, and other recurring HR deadlines.
* Support the CEO and fractional CFO with employee benefits administration, including enrollment materials, employee communications, records, and coordination with benefits providers.
* Assist with time off, payroll documentation, and leave paperwork as directed; route employment decisions and policy interpretations to the CEO or designated advisor.
* Help communicate HR policies and procedures, track acknowledgments, and flag questions or possible gaps for the CEO; support staff communications and employee engagement activities as assigned.

***Office Support***

* Share opening and closing duties with designated staff, following building access, alarm, visitor, and security procedures.
* Assist with office supplies, shared spaces, deliveries, and visitor needs as assigned; coordinate with the Inventory Manager, who handles routine building matters and mail.
* Provide logistical support for staff meetings, trainings, and all\-staff communications; maintain organized shared files and office records.
* Report safety, security, or facility concerns to the Inventory Manager and CEO promptly; refer lease matters and major building issues to the CEO.

**SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITES**

***Development Support*** 

When CEO, finance, HR, and office responsibilities permit:

* Enter and update donor and gift information in the development database using established procedures.
* Assist the Director of Development with donor acknowledgments, lists, event records, and other administrative tasks when assigned and scheduled.
* Coordinate gift records with the Development team and fractional CFO to support accurate financial and donor reporting.

Qualifications

* Three to five years of executive assistant, office management, or comparable administrative experience; experience with accounting or invoicing processes strongly preferred.
* Bachelor’s or Associate's degree in a related field preferred; substantial relevant experience may be considered in place of a degree.
* Strong calendar management, written communication, organization, spreadsheet, and follow through skills; proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
* Accuracy and discretion with financial, personnel, board, and donor information; ability to balance competing deadlines and ask for direction when priorities conflict.
* Experience with nonprofit donor databases, accounting software, HR records, and board coordination is preferred.

**Work Environment and Benefits**

* This is an on\-site position on TLC’s 9/80 schedule.
* TLC off

The role calls for sound judgment, accuracy, discretion, and the ability to manage shifting priorities.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

***Executive Support to the CEO***

* Manage the CEO’s calendar, scheduling, meeting preparation, travel arrangements, correspondence, and follow up on assigned priorities.
* Draft, edit, and organize CEO communications, reports, presentations, and confidential records.
* Coordinate Board of Directors and committee meeting logistics, including agendas, materials, minutes when assigned, and action item tracking.
* Serve as a responsive liaison between the CEO and staff, Board members, partners, and other stakeholders; keep organizational deadlines visible to the CEO.
* Track cross\-department projects and initiatives at the CEO’s direction, follow up with responsible staff, and report progress and outstanding decisions to the CEO.

**Operations Support**

***Accounts Payable, Receivable, and Banking***

* Receive and organize invoices, verify supporting documentation, code expenses according to TLC procedures, and route payments and reimbursements for approval.
* Prepare approved invoices, record incoming payments, monitor receivables, and follow up on outstanding balances in coordination with the fractional CFO.
* Prepare deposits and maintain banking and transaction records; coordinate routine bank inquiries and provide documentation for reconciliations and month\-end close.
* Track due dates and maintain accurate, confidential records for vendors, customers, payments, deposits, and restricted transactions as applicable.
* Follow TLC’s financial controls and approval limits; the position does not approve its own transactions or independently authorize payments.

***Human Resources Administration***

* Coordinate job postings, candidate scheduling and communications, onboarding and offboarding checklists, and required personnel paperwork.
* Maintain confidential employee files and track evaluation dates, policy acknowledgments, training records, and other recurring HR deadlines.
* Support the CEO and fractional CFO with employee benefits administration, including enrollment materials, employee communications, records, and coordination with benefits providers.
* Assist with time off, payroll documentation, and leave paperwork as directed; route employment decisions and policy interpretations to the CEO or designated advisor.
* Help communicate HR policies and procedures, track acknowledgments, and flag questions or possible gaps for the CEO; support staff communications and employee engagement activities as assigned.

***Office Support***

* Share opening and closing duties with designated staff, following building access, alarm, visitor, and security procedures.
* Assist with office supplies, shared spaces, deliveries, and visitor needs as assigned; coordinate with the Inventory Manager, who handles routine building matters and mail.
* Provide logistical support for staff meetings, trainings, and all\-staff communications; maintain organized shared files and office records.
* Report safety, security, or facility concerns to the Inventory Manager and CEO promptly; refer lease matters and major building issues to the CEO.

**SECONDARY RESPONSIBILITES**

***Development Support*** 

When CEO, finance, HR, and office responsibilities permit:

* Enter and update donor and gift information in the development database using established procedures.
* Assist the Director of Development with donor acknowledgments, lists, event records, and other administrative tasks when assigned and scheduled.
* Coordinate gift records with the Development team and fractional CFO to support accurate financial and donor reporting.

Qualifications

* Three to five years of executive assistant, office management, or comparable administrative experience; experience with accounting or invoicing processes strongly preferred.
* Bachelor’s or Associate's degree in a related field preferred; substantial relevant experience may be considered in place of a degree.
* Strong calendar management, written communication, organization, spreadsheet, and follow through skills; proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
* Accuracy and discretion with financial, personnel, board, and donor information; ability to balance competing deadlines and ask for direction when priorities conflict.
* Experience with nonprofit donor databases, accounting software, HR records, and board coordination is preferred.

**Work Environment and Benefits**

* This is an on\-site position on TLC’s 9/80 schedule.

jobs.title: Full-Time Youth Fitness Coach / Ninja Coach & Program Specialist
jobs.description:
Full\-Time Youth Fitness Coach / Ninja Coach \& Program Specialist

**USA Ninja Challenge Dublin, CA**  
**Two Full\-Time Openings \| $21–$25/hour \| Paid Training**

Help Kids Become Happy, Healthy \& Strong

USA Ninja Challenge Dublin is looking for dependable, energetic full\-time coaches who want to make a lasting impact on children.

Our coaches help kids develop strength, coordination, confidence, resilience, and the courage to keep trying when something is difficult. We’re looking for people who enjoy that work and want to help build a strong program for our athletes and families.

**Previous ninja experience is not required.** We will train you in our obstacles, curriculum, spotting, class structure, and safety procedures. Experience working with children is strongly preferred for this full\-time role.

What You’ll Do:

Coach Classes and Develop Athletes

* Lead groups and obstacle stations for children approximately ages 4–17
* Explain and demonstrate skills in ways children can understand
* Follow lesson plans and skill progressions
* Keep athletes active, engaged, and appropriately challenged
* Spot athletes and maintain a safe, structured class
* Give specific encouragement and constructive feedback
* Help assess and track athlete progress
* Communicate professionally with parents about their child’s experience

Support Camps, Parties, and Special Programs

Full\-time coaches help deliver programs beyond weekly classes, including:

* School\-break and summer camps
* Birthday parties
* Parents’ Night Out
* Clinics and special events
* Group visits and field trips
* Community activities

As you develop, you may take ownership of an assigned program: preparing for it, helping staff deliver it consistently, identifying problems, and improving the experience for families.

Help Keep the Gym Ready

* Prepare and reset obstacles and equipment
* Complete assigned safety checks
* Help open and close the facility
* Keep coaching areas clean and organized
* Support check\-in and help families when needed
* Prepare for upcoming classes, camps, and events
* Identify equipment or facility concerns and communicate them promptly

Strengthen the Coaching Team

As you become proficient in our program, you may help train newer coaches, model strong class management, and reinforce our coaching and safety standards.

Who We’re Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you:

* Genuinely enjoy working with children
* Can lead a group with both warmth and structure
* Bring positive energy throughout a shift
* Are dependable and punctual
* Communicate clearly with children, parents, and teammates
* Take coaching and apply feedback
* Pay close attention to safety
* Notice work that needs to be done and take initiative
* Can manage responsibilities beyond teaching your assigned class
* Want to grow as a coach and leader

Experience in youth sports, camps, teaching, childcare, after\-school programs, recreation, gymnastics, parkour, climbing, martial arts, or fitness is valuable. You do not need experience in every area. We care about your ability to connect with children, learn our system, and perform reliably.

What a Full\-Time Week May Include

Class coaching is concentrated in weekday afternoons and evenings. The rest of the role may include camps, parties, staff training, program preparation, equipment readiness, athlete evaluations, and operational tasks.

Weekend work is part of this position. Schedules will vary with classes, school breaks, and events, but we are looking for someone who can commit to a consistent schedule of approximately **40 hours per week**, including weekday evenings and weekends.

Growth Path

We want full\-time coaches to see a future here:

**Full\-Time Coach → Senior Coach → Lead Coach → Assistant Manager**

Growth comes with demonstrated responsibility. A coach ready for the next step can independently run strong classes, maintain safety standards, earn families’ trust, help other coaches improve, and take ownership of programs and daily operations.

We provide feedback so you know what to work on. Advancement is based on performance and the needs of the business, rather than a fixed amount of time in the role.

Compensation

**$21–$25 per hour**, depending on relevant experience, demonstrated coaching ability, and responsibilities. Training is paid.

Physical Requirements

This is an active coaching role. You should be comfortable standing and moving for extended periods, demonstrating athletic movements and techniques, assisting children on obstacles, and moving equipment as needed.

About USA Ninja Challenge Dublin

Our mission is to help kids become **Happy, Healthy \& Strong — one obstacle at a time.**

We use obstacle training to teach more than physical skills. Children learn to face challenges, practice perseverance, celebrate progress, and build confidence. Our coaches shape that experience every day.

Selected candidates will be invited to a phone interview and may participate in a practical, supervised coaching evaluation.

Pay: $21\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Opportunities for advancement
* Paid training

Application Question(s):

* Can you consistently work approximately 40 hours per week, including weekday afternoons and evenings?
* Can you commit to a consistent weekly schedule for at least the next six months?
* How much hands\-on experience do you have working with children?
* Briefly describe your experience coaching, teaching, supervising, or leading children. What ages did you work with?
* Tell us about a program, event, project, or ongoing responsibility you owned. What did you do, and what was the result?
* Are you within 20 minutes driving distance of the location and can reliably commute?

Work Location: In person

The **Operations Coordinator** plays a vital role in supporting maintenance operations. * Schedule pre\-move\-out and final move\-out inspections with residents, which may be conducted in person or virtually as needs demand.
* Create purchase orders for vendor services and track vendor\-related work orders.
* Schedule vendors for unit turnovers based on inspection findings.
* Monitor unit turnover and maintenance work orders to ensure timely completion.
* Respond to onsite emergencies and coordinate with the onsite team, including providing in\-person support and coverage as needed for colleagues at other locations.
* Partner with CMS Project Manager in supporting various asset improvement and preventative maintenance projects. Be the Community Management stakeholder of each project.
* Assist in scheduling and granting property access for projects led by Project Execution and sustainability, which can require onsite presence to facilitate.
* Communicate with on\-site team and residents in person (or telephonically and virtually when not possible) to confirm work completion, gather feedback, and recommend improvements.

* Other responsibilities as deemed necessary by the company as part of the ordinary course of business.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with property management or CRM software.
* Prior experience in customer service or property management is preferred.
* Commitment to providing exceptional customer service and a desire to help people.
* Strong organizational and time management skills to handle multiple responsibilities effectively.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a centralized hub environment.
* Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English.
* Capability to utilize a personal smart device for apps related to property operations and communication.
* Ability to work onsite to complete essential job functions outlined above and as arise in the ordinary course of the job.

* Maintain alignment with Essex policies and procedures while effectively managing relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Maintain compliance with all applicable laws, e.g., Fair Housing, Landlord Tenant, Local Building Codes, OSHA, and EEOC.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to create, compose, and edit written materials.
* Regular, consistent, and timely attendance required.
* This role requires a five\-day workweek that will likely include weekend coverage. Work is primarily performed at an Essex office location, involving extended periods of sitting at a desk or workstation, with the regular need to deliver resident notices. This may involve walking and use of stairs for prolonged periods of time.
* Travel required for occasional meetings and training.

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE TABLE:**

* Decisions made with thorough understanding of procedures, company policies, and business practices to achieve general results and deadlines.
* Team\-oriented mindset with a commitment to efficiency and service excellence.
* Initiative to enhance workflows and optimize maintenance processes.
* Detail\-focused approach to tracking and managing vendor relationships.
* Strong communication skills to foster positive resident experiences.
* Ability to exercise initiative.
* Ability to meet all job requirements and assignments.

### **\#LI\-Onsite**


All full\-time regular associates are offered competitive salaries, experience career growth, and are eligible for benefit packages that include medical, dental, vision, paid parental leave, 401k employer match, excellence rewards, wellness programs, and much more. Essex provides great communities in which to live, work and invest. We are a purpose\-driven company, and we pride ourselves on promoting an internal culture of growth and opportunity by engaging, enabling, and empowering our teams. Working at Essex is not a destination. It is a journey where you can confidently build your career.


New hires generally start between $26\.92 \- $31\.25 per hour. The final salary offer will be determined after reviewing relevant factors, including but not limited to skill sets; relevant experience; internal equity; and other business and organizational needs.
This role is also eligible to participate in Essex’s discretionary Annual Bonus program that is commensurate with the level of the position.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Cannabis Social Media & Content Specialist
jobs.description:
Cannabis Social Media \& Content Specialist

**Purple Star MD – San Francisco, CA**

Purple Star MD is seeking a creative, organized, and dependable **Social Media \& Content Specialist** to support and grow our digital presence.

This role is ideal for someone who understands social media, digital content, cannabis products, and the unique challenges of marketing a licensed cannabis retailer. Cannabis accounts often face platform restrictions, limited advertising options, content removals, and changing policies, so good judgment and attention to detail are important.

We are looking for someone who can create strong content, maintain accurate customer\-facing platforms, support promotions, and help strengthen the Purple Star MD brand across digital channels.

Responsibilities

* Create and publish content across social media platforms
* Develop posts, Stories, Reels, product highlights, promotions, and event content
* Photograph and film products, staff, displays, and store activity
* Edit short\-form video and create graphics using Canva, CapCut, Adobe, or similar tools
* Maintain a consistent content calendar and brand voice
* Keep Weedmaps, Leafly, Instagram, Google, Yelp, Facebook, and other digital platforms accurate and up to date
* Monitor reviews, comments, and direct messages
* Support product launches, vendor promotions, daily deals, and brand partnerships
* Coordinate content with in\-store promotions and current product offerings
* Track engagement, reach, views, profile activity, and other performance metrics
* Stay current on cannabis culture, social media trends, platform changes, and emerging brands
* Help protect the health of our social accounts while continuing to grow reach and engagement
* Assist with basic updates or administrative tasks within Meadow POS Admin as needed

Qualifications

* **Must be 21 years of age or older**
* **Must be familiar with cannabis products, brands, categories, and terminology**
* **Must be familiar with Weedmaps, Leafly, Instagram, Google, Yelp, Facebook, and other social media platforms**
* Experience creating social media content for a business, brand, or organization
* Strong writing and communication skills
* Basic photography and video\-editing skills
* Experience with Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools
* Strong organization and attention to detail
* Understanding of social media analytics and organic engagement
* Ability to work independently and consistently meet deadlines
* Familiarity with **Meadow POS Admin is a plus, but not required**

Previous cannabis industry experience is preferred.

Cannabis Social Media Requires a Different Approach

Marketing a cannabis retailer across social media comes with restrictions that do not exist in many other industries.

Licensed cannabis businesses may experience:

* Content removals
* Reduced organic reach
* Account warnings
* Advertising restrictions
* Limited promotional options
* Restricted features
* Account suspension or loss

The person in this role should understand the importance of staying current on platform policies and using good judgment when creating cannabis\-related content.

The goal is to build a strong, professional, and engaging digital presence while reducing unnecessary risk to the company's accounts.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is creative, reliable, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced retail environment.

The right candidate should be able to take a new product, promotion, vendor partnership, event, or store update and turn it into clear, engaging content.

You should also be comfortable maintaining multiple digital platforms, monitoring how the business appears online, and adjusting content based on performance and feedback.

Position Details

**Location:** San Francisco, CA  
**Schedule:** 30–40 hours per week  
**Work Location:** On\-site  
**Compensation:** Competitive and based on experience

This position will be performed on\-site at Purple Star MD. Regular in\-store presence is required to create original content, coordinate with staff, support promotions, and stay current on products and store activity.

Some evening, weekend, or event\-related availability may occasionally be needed.

To Apply

Please submit:

* Resume
* Links to social media or business accounts you have worked on
* Portfolio or examples of social media content, photography, video, graphics, or other creative work
* Brief introduction describing your experience with social media and cannabis

**Purple Star MD is a high\-volume San Francisco cannabis retailer looking for someone who can help strengthen our digital presence with creative, consistent, accurate, and professional content.**

Pay: $19\.61 \- $25\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 30\.0 – 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Compliance Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**

  

Nightingale Veterinary Partners is a fast\-growing family of veterinary practices, headquartered in New York City. The organization includes practices in New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, and Massachusetts.

  

We are building a company focused on clinical excellence, sustainable growth, and long\-term value creation. As we continue to grow, we are seeking a Compliance Program Coordinator who wants to play a meaningful role in shaping the organization's future.

  

**We are seeking an organized, proactive Compliance Program Coordinator** to help manage and maintain our legal, regulatory, licensing, and operational obligations.

  

This cross\-functional compliance role combines hands\-on responsibility with organization\-wide coordination. You will directly prepare and submit compliance filings, registrations, renewals, reports, and other required documentation. You will also partner with Finance, Human Resources, Operations, and other department leaders to identify requirements, communicate upcoming deadlines, monitor progress, maintain documentation, and escalate potential issues for compliance obligations owned by their departments.

  


**What Success Looks Like:**  

  

The Compliance Program Coordinator coordinates compliance efforts across departments. The right person is highly organized, comfortable following up with stakeholders, and able to manage numerous deadlines across multiple departments, business entities, and states.

  

Success in this role means creating a clear, reliable compliance process that helps every department understand its responsibilities, stay ahead of deadlines, and maintain the documentation needed to demonstrate compliance. Specifically:


* Maintain an accurate and up\-to\-date compliance calendar that gives departments sufficient notice of upcoming obligations and deadlines.
* Clearly communicate department\-specific responsibilities and deadlines to leadership.
* Assign compliance requirements to the appropriate owners and consistently track their progress through completion.
* Maintain organized and accessible records that are ready for audits, inspections, and internal reviews.
* Identify deadlines that are at risk of being missed and promptly escalate concerns to the appropriate leaders.
* Monitor changes in laws, regulations, and industry requirements and communicate relevant updates to affected departments.
* Coordinate internal reviews, external audits, regulatory inspections, and requests for supporting documentation.
* Strengthen compliance processes by developing and improving practical workflows, checklists, policies, and tracking tools.
* Coordinate with outside counsel, consultants, vendors, and regulatory agencies when additional  

guidance or support is needed.

  

  

**Required Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience
* 2\-3\+ years of experience coordinating compliance or regulatory requirements, preferably within a health care, veterinary, or other regulated organization
* Strong organizational and project\-management skills
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines and competing priorities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Confidence following up with stakeholders and holding others accountable for agreed\-upon deadlines
* Excellent attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate records
* Sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle confidential information
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint
* Ability to research requirements, summarize information clearly, and identify when an issue should be escalated


*Preferred Qualifications:*


* Experience coordinating compliance requirements across multiple states is preferred
* Experience supporting a multi\-location or multi\-entity organization

  


**What We Offer**


* The salary range for this role is: $75,000\-$90,000\. This salary range represents our target hiring range for this role. The proposed salary will be dependent on the candidate's skills, relevant experience, and competencies.
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* FSA/HSA
* Paid time off
* 401(k) with a company match
* Paid Parental Leave
* Elective benefits through MetLife
* Employee pet discounts
* Discounted pet insurance

  


**Work Environment**



This position is based at our headquarters in Chelsea, New York City, and **requires working in the office five days per week.**

  

**Come As You Are**



We provide equal opportunities for everyone who applies to and works for our company, regardless of  

age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, race, color, national origin, disability, and all other law\-protected considerations that make you, You.

The ideal candidate will provide effective leadership and support key programmatic functions including operational planning, resource management, staff development, curriculum implementation, and cross\-site collaboration. Wolf \& Badger is the leading global platform for independent, ethical and design\-led brands across fashion, beauty, home and lifestyle. As we scale our community of independent brands worldwide, we are expanding our Brand Partnerships team to bring on and support the next generation of purpose\-driven brands.

We are seeking a highly motivated, ambitious and organized Brand Partnerships Associate to support the growth of our brand community across North America. This is a varied role sitting across Brand Acquisition and Brand Success with a strong focus on supporting pipeline growth, prospecting and outreach while also managing relationships with existing brand partners.


This is a hybrid sales and account management role based in SoHo, NY, with responsibility across the brand membership lifecycle from prospecting, qualifying and onboarding new brands through to driving the ongoing success of a portfolio of independent brands on Wolf \& Badger.


The ideal candidate is a self\-starter with a growth mindset, strong organizational skills and a genuine passion for independent, ethical brands. You should also be AI\-savvy with an interest in using technology to improve prospecting, outreach, research and day\-to\-day workflows.

* Upselling: Present brands with marketing packages, retail media and physical store add\-ons in order to provide them with opportunities relevant to their stage of growth and development on the Wolf \& Badger platform.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the Community, Ops, Marketing and Retail teams to ensure seamless communication and collaboration on in\-store activations, organic marketing opportunities and special events, including providing hands\-on ad hoc support for brands at New York in\-store events. * Proactive, personable and commercially aware

* Build and present the US organic social strategy with the Group Senior Content Manager, tying every plan back to Hawksmoor's business objectives and marketing calendar.
* Turn brand plans and business goals into monthly and quarterly social plans for all three US restaurants, timed to wider business activity and moments that actually matter to our audience.
* Own the US social presence day to day, working with the wider marketing team to keep tone and message consistent across the UK and US.

*Content \& Scheduling*

* Manage day\-to\-day channel activity, including community management, across all platforms for the US market
* Ensure cohesion between social media activity and wider marketing channels
* Proactively introduce creative social campaigns tied to brand activity, business objectives and cultural moments
* Brief and collaborate with internal teams and external partners as required
* Educate and upskill the wider marketing team on social media trends and platform best practice
* Know which content works on which platform for which audience, and plan accordingly rather than posting the same thing everywhere.
* Plan and schedule daily activity so campaigns land on time and stay relevant.

*Community \& Engagement*

* Build genuine community, not just reply to comments and DMs on time, though that matters too. The goal is people who follow because they feel part of something.
* Build relationships with local influencers, creators and partners who fit the brand, to extend reach in each city.
* Spot opportunities for co\-creation, user\-generated content and local partnerships.

*Insights \& Performance*

* Track performance and use the data to sharpen content, not just to report on it.
* Report regularly on activity and results, and use what you learn to adjust strategy.
* Stay ahead of platform and algorithm changes, and know what's worth acting on versus what's just noise.


Requirements:

* 3–5 years' proven experience managing social media across multiple channels and content types, ideally in hospitality, food \& beverage, lifestyle or another premium, consumer\-facing brand.
* Hands\-on, proven experience managing Facebook, Instagram, TikTok end\-to\-end with a track record of managing high\-volume channels with large followings.
* A track record of turning brand plans and business objectives into organic social strategy that actually delivers.
* Real platform and audience expertise: you know what content works on which platform for which audience
* Exceptional attention to detail, the kind that shows up in every caption, crop and post time.
* A quality\-first instinct rather than a trend\-chasing one. Our guest is 35\+ and discerning; we want someone who can build content with real craft and restraint, not something that only works because it's this week's trend.
* Experience building community and engagement, not just managing it. Growing genuine audience connection rather than just responding to comments and messages.
* Sharp instincts for algorithm shifts, platform changes and emerging opportunities, and the initiative to act on them early.
* Content / asset creation skills a bonus but not necessity (Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, CapCut or similar).
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with real command of tone and brand voice.
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced environment with shifting priorities, which is normal in hospitality, and able to reprioritize without losing quality.
* Highly organized, confident managing your own timeline across time zones with the UK team.
* Pride in the work: every post represents the whole restaurant, and you treat it that way.
* Willingness to travel semi\-regularly between New York, Boston and Chicago.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**Content Creator \& Social Media Producer — Aura Factor**

**Location:** New York City  
**Commitment:** 15–20 hours per week  
**Type:** Part\-time  
**Schedule:** Flexible, with regular in\-person work in NYC

**About Aura Factor**

Aura Factor is an early\-stage high\-growth consumer wellness brand, focused initially on launching a single drink mix with visual beauty and inner health benefits, with a path to rapidly branching out into a wider array of related supplement products.

We believe content will be one of the most important ways people discover, understand, and connect with the brand. We're looking for a highly creative person to help us build that presence from the ground up.

This is not just a role where you'll receive a list of posts to execute. We want someone who can help us decide what we should make, make it exceptionally well, learn from what works, and continuously push the creative forward.

**The Role**

We're looking for a hands\-on content creator to help own Aura Factor's social content pipeline from idea through publication.

You'll work closely with the founders/team to develop content ideas, turn those ideas into still images and short\-form video, edit and refine the work, organize the content calendar, and publish finished content.

We're looking for someone with strong creative instincts who is equally comfortable coming up with an idea and picking up a camera or phone and making it happen.

**How to Apply**

In addition to applying on Indeed, please send the below to contact@aurafactor.co

* A short introduction about yourself (no more than two paragraphs; can be bullets)
* A link to your portfolio, Instagram, TikTok, website, or other examples of your work.
* 3–5 pieces of content you've made that best represent your taste and capabilities.
* A few sentences on a consumer brand you think is making unusually good content right now and why.
* Your availability and current location in New York.

Formal cover letters are not necessary.

We're primarily looking for great creative instincts, execution ability, curiosity, reliability, and excitement about building something.

**What You'll Do**

* Help develop Aura Factor's ongoing social content strategy and creative concepts
* Regularly ideate new still\-image and short\-form video concepts
* Collaborate with us to refine and prioritize ideas before production
* Plan and execute shoots in New York
* Shoot original photo and video content
* Use AI to create photo and video content
* Edit short\-form video for platforms such as Instagram Reels and TikTok
* Create and edit still imagery, carousels, and other social assets
* Adapt trends and cultural moments in ways that feel authentic to Aura Factor rather than simply copying what other brands are doing
* Maintain an organized pipeline of concepts, content in production, finished assets, and scheduled posts
* Publish approved content
* Review content performance and use what we learn to inform future creative
* Help continuously evolve the visual language and social presence of Aura Factor

**Who We're Looking For**

We're much more interested in your creative work than a particular résumé.

You may be a content creator, filmmaker, designer, social media creative, or someone whose work sits somewhere between those disciplines.

You should:

* Have a strong eye for composition, typography, imagery, editing, and visual storytelling
* Be able to shoot compelling content on a phone and/or camera
* Be comfortable editing short\-form video
* Understand what feels native to Instagram and TikTok
* Follow culture, creators, brands, visual trends, and emerging content formats
* Be able to translate a broad creative direction into an actual piece of content
* Be organized enough to manage several pieces of content at different stages of production
* Be comfortable receiving feedback and iterating collaboratively
* Be resourceful and willing to figure things out
* Be based in New York City and available to work together in person as needed
* Have a flexible schedule

Experience with tools such as CapCut, Canva, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Lightroom, or similar creative software is helpful, but we're more interested in the quality of your work than the exact tools you use.

Experience with consumer, wellness, fashion, food/beverage, beauty, fitness, or lifestyle brands is a plus but not required.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first few months, we'd like this person to become a meaningful owner of Aura Factor's content engine: maintaining a healthy pipeline of ideas, consistently producing high\-quality work, developing a strong understanding of the Aura Factor aesthetic, and helping us discover the types of content that resonate most with our audience.

The goal is not simply to post frequently. It is to build a recognizable brand and create content people actually want to watch, save, share, and engage with.

**Why This Role Is Interesting**

You'll have significantly more creative ownership than you would in a traditional internship or narrowly defined social media role.

You'll work directly with the team building the brand, see ideas move quickly from concept to execution, experiment with different formats and creative directions, and have the opportunity to meaningfully shape how an emerging consumer brand looks and feels.

For the right person, there is potential for the role to grow substantially as Aura Factor grows.

**Compensation**

$35 per hour

Approximately 15\-20 hours per week.

Pay: $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15\.0 – 20\.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10004

The on target earning range represents the low and high end of CLEAR's range for this position. The range listed is just one component of CLEAR's total compensation package for employees and other rewards may include annual bonuses, commission, Restricted Stock Units.


*Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.*

Please let us know if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job or perform your job. ------------


CompassionMD™ provides affordable, direct virtual medical care to individuals, families, small businesses, and large organizations nationwide. * Professional, organized, and self\-motivated

* **Performance\-based commissions**
* **Monthly residual income** for active subscribers you enroll
