**About Vega**
--------------


The $250B insurance claims industry runs on fax machines, phone tag, and adjusters buried in paperwork. Cycle times stretch for months. Data is locked in legacy systems. And the workforce is aging out faster than it's being replaced.


Vega is the premier AI\-native claims TPA built to replace that entire stack. Our team is equal parts experienced insurance operators and modern technologists. We care deeply about delivering superior outcomes for our clients, and we want builders that get their hands dirty shipping solutions that move the needle.


Our results: 10x YoY revenue growth, and on track for $XXM run\-rate in under 2 years. Backed by marquee VCs like General Catalyst, Lightspeed and Valor.

**The Role**
------------


As an SDR on our growing sales team, you will play a key role in driving the outbound engine behind Vega's growth.


You will work closely with leadership and our Account Executives to generate pipeline, refine our messaging, and sharpen the playbook as the team scales. This is an opportunity for someone who loves the energy of outbound and wants a fast path to AE or GTM leadership as the team grows.


You'll engage senior decision\-makers across carriers, MGAs, and claims organizations, opening conversations about how AI can modernize one of the most critical functions in insurance.


We believe there's real value in being together as a team. We come into our New York City office 4 days per week, which gives us space to collaborate, move quickly, and build strong relationships with the people we work alongside.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Target and engage carriers and MGAs, generating pipeline for high\-value, AI\-native claims solutions
* Own your outbound motion end\-to\-end, including cold calls, email automation, LinkedIn, and conferences
* Build and expand target lists, sharpening our ICP across the commercial insurance landscape
* Run discovery to qualify high\-value opportunities and turn first conversations into real ARR
* Partner with leadership and our Account Executives to refine messaging, test what works, and sharpen our sales playbook
* Optimize your workflow and tooling to get the most out of every hour
* Represent Vega at industry events and conferences (travel required)

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 1–2\+ years in SDR, business development, or another performance\-driven GTM role, with a proven track record of generating outbound pipeline
* You prioritize speed and action, above all else, and see rejection as opportunity
* Genuinely curious about AI and how it reshapes traditional industries, and able to explain complex AI value propositions clearly and confidently to senior insurance executives
* You think in systems and thrive on high\-volume outbound in a fast\-growing startup
* Owner mentality: you take accountability for outcomes, not just activity
* Nice to have: experience in InsurTech or FinTech

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive Salary
* Equity \- giving you direct stake in the future of an AI\-native industry leader.
* Top\-tier medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401k with company match.
* Flexible PTO and a work from home stipend.
* A fast\-paced, high\-talent density team that values transparency and shipping fast.

*Vega is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. We'd like to consider you for this position and roles that may be a fit in the future.*

*Vega is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, state, or local law. Vega considers all qualified applicants in accordance with the New York Fair Chance Ordinance.*


Compensation Range: $90K \- $120K

Join Brightree as a Customer Success Manager and become a trusted advisor to healthcare providers who rely on our solutions to streamline operations and focus on delivering exceptional patient care. In this role, you'll partner with customer leaders to understand their business goals, identify opportunities for improvement, and help drive measurable outcomes through effective adoption of Brightree products and services. * Ability to build relationships with customer leaders and communicate strategic recommendations with confidence and credibility.
* Strong consultative, presentation, and communication skills.

* Understanding of medical insurance billing and reimbursement processes involving providers, patients, and insurance carriers.
* Strong problem\-solving, conflict resolution, active listening, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent financial and business acumen.
* Ability to travel domestically up to 20\-30%.

* Experience managing and resolving customer escalations for large, regional, or multi\-product accounts.
* Infusion pharmacy experience.
* Experience using Gainsight.

* Proactive Problem Solver — You identify risks early and take action before they become larger issues.
* Relationship Builder — You create strong partnerships across different stakeholder groups and levels of an organization.
* Ownership Mentality — You take responsibility for outcomes and follow through on commitments.
* Continuous Improvement Focus — You look for better ways of working and help customers realize greater value over time.

At ResMed, our mission is to help people live healthier, higher\-quality lives through innovative healthcare technology. Your work will directly help customers improve operational performance, increase efficiency, and focus more of their time on patient care. Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now! We commit to respond to every applicant.

At RangeWater, we look for people who show up and work together to achieve success and make positive impacts on the lives we touch and enrich the communities we serve, as people are at the heart of everything we do. As a Ranger, we encourage you to explore possibilities and solutions for your own career success story and apply the same enthusiasm to help RangeWater remain THE leader and powerful force in Multi\-Family Real Estate.

***Our Team Members play a pivotal role in the success of the company’s performance, and we look forward to*** ***witnessing your successful journey as a Ranger!***

**Culture:** Companies with a strong culture and a higher purpose perform better in the long run.

**Core Values** (words to live by): People\-focused, Collaboration, Integrity, Service, Results\-driven, Experience\-centric, and Innovation.

**What’s in for you?** Our leaders care about the well\-being of all Rangers and recognize the importance of work\-life balance. That’s why we offer competitive paid time off and benefits.

**PTO/Benefits:**

* Two \+ Weeks of PTO
* Paid Holidays
* Medical, dental and vision insurance
* 401(k) Enrollment Opportunity

Ensures that the operation of the property complies with Company policies and procedures and all laws and regulations governing multi\-family housing operations.

* Monday – Friday: 9am – 6pm

* Sunday: 1pm – 5pm

* Must be available to work on weekends when scheduled and must be able to perform the essential job functions unaccompanied.
* Works in an office environment but also have frequent exposure to outside elements where temperatures, weather, odors, and/or landscape may be unpleasant and/or hazardous.

jobs.title: Accelerated Management Program Associate - Sales
jobs.description:
Did you know? Daikin is the world's \#1 manufacturer of air conditioners and refrigerants and provides the North American market with a full range of residential and commercial HVAC products leveraging its advanced core technologies for refrigerant control, inverters and heat pumps. Headquartered just outside of Houston, Texas, the Daikin Texas Technology Park (DTTP) allows Daikin to consolidate manufacturing, engineering, logistics, marketing and sales in a 4\.2 million square feet state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing and business campus. We can fit 74 football fields with their end zones inside our building! In addition to the DTTP, we have 210 company owned branches located around North America.


* **We are looking for candidates for our Alpharetta, GA branch with an interest in the Sales side of our business. Must graduate between December 2026 to May 2027\.**


**WORK WITH A LEADER**



As a family of brands backed by Daikin Industries, Ltd., Daikin, Goodman, Motili, and Quietflex bring innovation and value to indoor comfort products and services—but we can’t do it alone. Be a part of our team! Our goal is simple: to help customers live, play, and work comfortably indoors. But while we’re delivering industry\-leading indoor comfort products and services to our customers—we’re also committed to helping our employees thrive, too. In fact, the success of our employees is what helps define our success as an organization. That’s why we instill a culture of training, mentorship, and opportunity. Here, our work runs on collaboration, and our people have the confidence to ask questions, challenge ideas, and solve problems in unexpected ways. As part of our family of brands, our team members have immense opportunity to grow—and the confidence of working in a strong and expanding industry.


**ACCELERATED MANAGEMENT PROGRAM**



Seeking a career and not just a job? Daikin is looking for students to join our Accelerated Management Program (AMP). AMP can provide you with the tools you need for success within our company. On this twelve month program, you will work hands\-on from the ground up and be provided with the opportunity to explore the facets of our company that could fit your personal skills and interests. Daikin’s Accelerated Management Program includes two focuses: Branch Operations and Outside Sales Track.


**Operational Focus:**


* Counter Sales: Work face\-to\-face with customers while gaining product knowledge and learning our systems and processes
* Warehouse: Hands\-on experience with our products, including shipping and receiving materials
* Inside/Showroom Sales: Further develop the daily skills needed to become a successful Branch leader, while building relationships with our customers and sales force
* Other aspects include: developing leadership skills, providing accurate pricing and inventory information, and developing and maintaining relationships


**Outside Sales Focus:**


* Help drive business development and prospecting. You will start your fast\-track training into outside sales with an actual territory in one of designated markets.
* Managing Customer priorities: Learn the importance of meeting the customer’s demand for quick response times, on\-site solutions, and on\-time complete delivery. You will also focus time on learning how to manage all sales functions for existing and prospective customers
* Houston Training: Visit our corporate location in Houston, TX to network and build relationships with corporate leaders and other support teams
* Other aspects include: a focus on new business development, meeting sales goals, and building relationships with key stakeholders


**Nature \& Scope:**


* Possesses a broad theoretical job knowledge typically obtained through advanced education
* Has no discretion to deviate from established procedures by performing structured work assignments
* Work is closely supervised
* Problems faced are not typically difficult nor complex
* Explains facts, policies and practices related to job area


**Knowledge \& Skills:**


* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Leadership: Ability to motivate and manage teams effectively.
* Analytical Thinking: Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Decision Making: Ability to make informed and timely decisions.
* Time Management: Efficient time management and ability to prioritize tasks.
* Negotiation: Effective negotiation skills to manage contracts, partnerships, and conflict resolution.
* Interpersonal Skills: Strong interpersonal skills to build relationships with team members, stakeholders, and clients.
* Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing environments and handle unexpected challenges.
* Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with business software such as Microsoft Office Suite, project management tools, and ERP systems.
* Financial Acumen: Ability to understand and manage budgets, financial statements, and cost analysis.
* Customer Focus: Understanding customer needs and ensuring satisfaction.


**Education/Certification:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Management, Marketing, Sales, Entrepreneurial Studies (or similar)
* Must have at least a 3\.0 GPA (overall and major)


**People Management:** No


**Physical Requirements / Work Environment:**


* Must be able to perform essential responsibilities with or without reasonable accommodations
* Must have long term flexibility in location within the region (but national opportunities may be available as well) and be willing to relocate for career opportunity upon completion of program.

jobs.title: Territory Sales Representative - St. Louis, MO
jobs.description:
**Atlas Roofing Corporation**, a privately owned company established in 1982, is an innovative, customer\-oriented leading provider of high\-performance roofing and construction materials that help build better environments to live and work. **Atlas Roofing Corporation** has grown from a single roofing shingle manufacturing facility in 1982 into an industry leader with facilities in North America and worldwide product distribution. **Atlas Roofing Corporation** is made up of 4 divisions: Roof and Wall Insulation, Shingles, Underlayments \& Ventilation, Web Technologies, and Molded Products.





**Atlas Roofing Shingles, Underlayments \& Ventilation** is seeking a **Territory Sales Representative** for **Missouri** residing in **St. Louis, MO** area**.**





**!!!! Bonus potential and car allowance reimbursement program provided!!!**





**Territory Sales Representative Primary Responsibilities**


* Build an ongoing relationship at the contractor, dealer, distributor and builder level.
* Knowledgeable of all Atlas Products, programs, and sales \& marketing tools.
* Maintain awareness of market pricing, product innovations, competitive product lines and market trends that may affect your market.
* Help establish and maintain competitive market pricing through timely and accurate gathering and communication of competitive market information.
* Communicate accurate information daily with Regional Sales Manager, Plant Manager, Account Executives, and other Territory Sales Representatives on developments impacting their areas of responsibility.
* Communicate with customers in a timely manner.
* Inspect and assist in resolving complaints that develop periodically in a timely and professional manner that will maintain business on a steady growth pattern; provide adequate follow\-up.
* Work with contractors and dealers for pull\-though sales of Atlas products to our distributors and ensures Atlas has adequate distribution in the assigned market area.
* Provide the necessary literature, samples, technical data, and other advertising materials needed in the field.
* Promote and display the entire family of Atlas products by attending distributor, dealer, and builder shows.
* Promote new products and keeps customers informed of promotions, special offers, and incentive opportunities.
* Participate in joint sales calls with distributor and dealer salespeople.
* Design business plans that meet both Atlas and distributor's expectations; evaluate customer performance on a quarterly and yearly basis and reports the results to the Region Sales Manager.
* Follow up on quotes and ensure the proper documentation has been sent to the appropriate Account Executives and the Pricing Manager.


**Territory Sales Representative Experience**


* Two (2\) years' experience minimum in the building material industry or at least four years in a field sales capacity is preferred.


**Territory Sales Representative Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**


* Fluent in English (Reading, Writing, Speaking), Bi\-lingual is a plus.
* Professional selling skills are critical
* Ability to read, analyze and interpret technical procedures and government regulations
* Present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, customers, employees, and the general public
* Computer skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, People Soft)
* Responds to customer requests in a timely manner
* Acts fairly and ethically in all business dealing


**Education, Licenses \& Certifications**


* Four (4\) year degree is preferred


**Total Compensation**


* **Atlas Roofing Corporation** offers competitive compensation and vacation/holiday package as well as a comprehensive benefits program including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life/AD\&D/LTD insurance, 401k and Flexible Spending Accounts.


***Atlas Roofing Corporation*** *is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.*





***No calls or agencies please.***





In the **Atlas Roofing Shingles, Underlayments \& Ventilation division,** we strive to be the easiest manufacturing company to work with while providing the best experience for our stakeholder communities, as a premier residential roofing manufacturer.





**Our mission is shown through our core operating principles:**

* **Big Enough to Serve –** We will be as big as we need to be to ensure our customers' needs are met to the Atlas standard. We will not sacrifice being the best at what we do for being the biggest in the market, and this makes us unique.
* **Small Enough to Listen –** We have a learning first attitude, seeking to better understand our customers' needs. We will always work to be the best by being open, fast, flexible, accessible, and adaptive.
* **Tough Enough to Last –** We make high\-quality products while building relationships with our customers that exceed expectations. We are resilient and dependable in the face of adversity and work collaboratively to create the best outcomes.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - East
jobs.description:

Roshal Health anticipates significant growth over the next two years and is seeking a motivated, positive, experienced Business Development Representative to join our growing Sales team. The BDR position is a full\-time, salaried \& commissioned, primarily remote position. Our full\-time employees are eligible for full benefits (Med/Den/Vis/401K) and PTO.



The Business Development Representative role will be responsible for managing client accounts, fostering relationships, and driving sales of healthcare and Diagnostic Medical Imaging products and services. This is a primarily remote position with residency in this area required



 REQUIREMENTS:


* **Bachelor's degree in related field highly preferred**
* **Proven 2\+ year track record of success in national sales, within the healthcare and/or Diagnostic Imaging setting and/or other healthcare consulting or staffing industries**
* **Experience in calling into hospitals, healthcare systems and FSEDs**
* Proven ability to thrive in a high\-volume outbound prospecting environment with persistent follow\-up via phone and email

All qualified individuals will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, or another protected status under federal, state, or local laws.*

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
We are Builders FirstSource, America’s largest supplier of building materials, value\-added components and building services to the professional market. You’ll feel proud of the work you do here every day to transform the future of home building and help make the dream of home ownership more achievable. At BFS, we believe building a successful career is not solely defined by a degree. Your experience, skills, and passion are just as important, if not more so. As such, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace that welcomes candidates from all backgrounds and experience levels.
  
  

PURPOSE
  
  

Demonstrates in\-depth knowledge experience and skills to effectively represent the company with the largest or most complex customers. Understand customer’s needs and identifies products and services to meet these requirements. Participates in a leadership role helping train and develop less experienced members of the sales staff. May also act as Sales Manager during his/her absence.
  
  

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  
* Represents the company during the sales process by collecting data on customer needs and design specifications, and acting as a liaison between inside technical/design staff and customer in developing sales proposals. Possesses the experience and knowledge to effectively handle complex or highly specialized customer requirements.
* Develops sales contracts for a wide range of projects, including residential, multi\-family and commercial, by collecting specification information from the client’s engineer or architect of record and conveying needs and changes to technical staff and management.
* Troubleshoots field issues which may be difficult to resolve or are complex in nature.
* Effectively plans and conducts sales presentations for current and prospective customers. Designs professional demonstrations or presentations of company products and services and provides clarification on how we can meet their specific needs.
* Researches, identifies and solicits new customers. Generates sales opportunities through research on client needs, industry competition and effective demonstration of the features and benefits of the company’s products and services.
* Continuously updates customers on products and services and provides explanations how these products and services meet current or future customer requirements.
* Participates in a leadership role, such as chairing meetings, acting in the Sales Manager’s capacity during his/her absence and helping train and develop less experienced members of the sales staff.
* May provide training to less experienced Outside Sales Reps
* Prepares recurring and special reports, forms or other documentation for management, as required.
* Enhances knowledge of sales techniques and expands product and industry knowledge by attending company\-sponsored training programs. May serve as presenter at training programs to assist in the development of less experienced Outside Sales Reps.
* Plans and paces own work efficiency in order to meet daily, weekly, project or team\-related productivity goals

* Carries out other duties as assigned.

Bachelor’s degree in Sales, Marketing or related field plus two (2\) years prior sales experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  
  

COMPETENCIES
  
  

* In\-depth knowledge of company products, services, production processes and product standards
* In\-depth understanding of policies and procedures relating to sales and customer service
* Ability to maintain confidentiality regarding sensitive information, including company information and customer\-specific information
* Demonstrated professionalism, diplomacy and tact to portray the company in a positive manner

* Attention to detail

jobs.title: REMOTE SALES REPRESENTATIVE (Virtual Healthcare Services)
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------


CompassionMD™ provides affordable, direct virtual medical care to individuals, families, small businesses, and large organizations nationwide. Our model gives people 24/7 access to board\-certified doctors, virtual urgent care, mental health consultations, medical guidance, and other valuable health services at predictable, transparent pricing.


We are expanding across the United States and are seeking motivated **Sales Representatives** who can introduce our direct virtual care programs to consumers and to organizations of all sizes.

**Position Overview**
---------------------


This is a **sales\-focused**, **remote**, **performance\-based** role suited for someone who:

* Has an existing client base, business network, or broad community influence
* Has experience selling to **individuals**, **small businesses**, or **mid\-to\-large organizations**
* Is comfortable offering a subscription\-based virtual healthcare program
* Wants to build **recurring residual income** through ongoing membership renewals
* Prefers flexible work hours and autonomy


You will present, promote, and help enroll people and organizations into CompassionMD™ virtual health subscription plans.

**What You’ll Sell**
--------------------


Our direct virtual care programs include:

* 24/7 doctor access
* Virtual urgent care
* Medical guidance \& care navigation
* Mental health consultations
* Prescription support
* Hospital bill negotiation services
* Additional associated benefits


Plans are priced to be affordable for individuals, families, and organizations.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Sell CompassionMD™ virtual health subscriptions nationwide
* Conduct outreach to individuals, families, and organizations
* Present our services to small and mid\-sized businesses (bulk enrollment options)
* Work with groups, associations, nonprofits, and employers
* Manage your own leads or use your existing network
* Track enrollments and customer follow\-up
* Collaborate with internal support teams for onboarding

**Ideal Candidate**
-------------------

* Experience in **sales**, **benefits**, **healthcare**, **insurance**, **affiliate marketing**, or **business development**
* Strong existing network or the ability to build one
* Excellent communication skills
* Professional, organized, and self\-motivated
* Comfortable working independently
* Tech\-savvy and confident presenting virtually

*No healthcare license is required.*

**Compensation**
----------------

* **Performance\-based commissions**
* **Monthly residual income** for active subscribers you enroll
* **Unlimited** earning potential tied directly to your production
* All commission structures are fully disclosed during the interview

**Why This Role Appeals to Top Salespeople**
--------------------------------------------

* Work entirely from home
* National market—no territory limitations
* Highly relevant product (healthcare is universally needed)
* Subscription model allows ongoing monthly earnings
* Strong value proposition for individuals AND businesses
* Backed by a national virtual health platform

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Assistant Project Manager is responsible for assisting with activities concerned with the construction and maintenance of structures, facilities and systems. This position participates in the conceptual development of a construction project and oversee its organization, scheduling and implementation. In this role you may be required to travel up to 10% of the time.


**Responsibilities:**


* Update schedule with supplied information.
* Follow up and maintain timely material deliveries.
* Assist in estimating and soliciting subcontractors in the bidding and pricing process.
* Checkout qualifications of subcontractors. Review same for final approval with Project Manager.
* Assist in maintain the Job Cost Report, ledgers, and cost.
* Maintain SBI report.
* Assist in preparing, reviewing for accuracy and issuing change orders to subcontractors, and material vendors.
* Assist in preparing monthly pay applications and obtaining lien releases from subcontractors and vendors as needed.
* Prepare meeting minutes for all on site meetings with subcontractors and Owner.
* Prepare and monitor all requests for information (RFI's) and maintain RFI Log.
* Receive, review, check and monitor the entire submittal process.
* Maintain current construction documents.

**Requirements:**


* Bachelor's Degree in Building Science, Construction Management, Civil Engineering or related field preferred
* 1\-3 years experience in the construction industry required, healthcare construction experience preferred.
* Experience with construction project management software such as Procore, Viewpoint, Revit and VICO.
* BIM, MS Excel and MS Word required
* LEED AP and/or Design\-Build Institute of America a plus
* Valid Driver's License required

**Physical Demands and Working Environment:**


*The conditions herein are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.*


Environment: Work is performed mainly in an indoor and outdoor setting with exposure to all types of weather and temperature conditions, and travel from site to site.


Physical: Primary functions require sufficient physical ability and mobility to work in an office setting and field environment (construction site); to walk, stand, and sit for prolonged periods of time; to frequently stoop, bend, kneel, crouch, crawl, climb, reach, twist, grasp, and make repetitive hand movement in the performance of daily duties; to lift, carry, push, and/or pull moderate amounts of weight up to 50 lbs without assistance and greater than 50lbs with assistance; to operate assigned equipment and vehicles; and to verbally communicate to exchange information.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
At MacKay, we believe great people are the foundation of our growth and success.



We are in an exciting phase of expansion, creating new opportunities for our employees to take on meaningful work, collaborate across disciplines, and build long\-term careers. Whether your role is technical or part of our support services team, you play an important role in delivering high\-quality work and helping our projects succeed.


We're seeking a proactive, relationship\-focused, and highly organized **Project Coordinator** to join our dynamic team in Chicago, IL. In this critical role, you'll primarily support these teams, with additional duties across other areas, including coordinating activities, managing documentation, and facilitating efficient communication among team members.



The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, collaborative, and thrives in a fast\-paced, multitasking environment. We would love to connect with you if you are eager to drive impact and advance your career within a collaborative, purpose\-driven team.



This is a hybrid role based in our downtown Chicago office, which is conveniently located and easily accessible via public transit. The office features several gathering spaces, a workout space, a cafe, and a food truck, with lobby events geared toward mingling and networking



Key Responsibilities:


* Project Delivery: Learn MacKay's project management systems and standards. Partner with project managers to ensure all projects meet internal performance requirements for documentation, communication, and quality control.
* Project Setup and Closeout: Assist project managers in creating draft contact lists, coordinating internal quality reviews, and approvals of Project Management Plans.
* General Project Support: Assist project analysts and project managers with daily project needs as assigned, including the tracking of project progress, preparation of status reports and project write\-ups, and assisting project managers with communicating updates to stakeholders.
* ERP System Data Entry and Support: Utilize Vantagepoint database to enter data, develop reports, support team invoicing and the revenue forecasting process, and provide best practices for cross\-functional teams.
* Build and strengthen direct, close relationships among staff and ensure efficient communication.
* Bring a continuous improvement mindset to proactively identify opportunities to increase project management support and improve team operating procedures to increase efficiency and effective communication.
* Assist in managing necessary communications to clients, staff, and subconsultants with necessary project information.
* Assist in the preparation and tracking of project proposals, scopes, schedules, and budgets
* Maintain and update project documentation, including contracts, permits, submittals, RFIs, and change orders.
* Organize and participate in project meetings, team events, prepare agendas, and take meeting minutes.
* Support the preparation of project billing and invoicing.
* Provide additional administrative support to Project Managers and project teams, such as calendar management, project reporting, email correspondence, travel, conference registrations, and other general administrative duties.


 Qualifications:


* A bachelor's degree in business administration or equivalent experience is preferred but not required.
* Minimum of four years of experience in project coordination or a similar role, preferably within the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in Google Office Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides).
* Must be proactive, self\-motivated, able to multitask, prioritize, work both independently and in a team environment, and work under deadline pressures.
* The ability to interface effectively and professionally with clients, consultants, and the community at large.


### **Why Join MacKay?**



A people\-first culture  

At MacKay, we put people first. We are committed to creating an environment where employees can grow, contribute, and do their best work. We support well\-being, encourage balance, and create space for people to succeed both professionally and personally.



Meaningful work and real impact  

Our teams take on complex infrastructure and environmental challenges that support critical systems and shape the places where people live and work. Every role contributes to delivering that work and making it successful.



Growth and opportunity

jobs.title: Service & Project Coordinator, US
jobs.description:
*Ready to help keep our growing U.S. operations running smoothly?*


IMBOX is growing rapidly across North America, and we are looking for a structured and hands\-on Service \& Project Coordinator to join our Service \& Operations team in Chicago.


In this role, you will coordinate daily shipments, installations and removals, support service requests, and keep our retail partners informed. You will also help drive projects such as new store rollouts, machine exchanges and process improvements.


You will become an important part of a young, fast\-moving team where collaboration, ownership and a practical mindset are at the heart of how we work.

**What you will do**


Your responsibilities will include:

* Coordinating daily outbound shipments, store installations and machine removals
* Tracking shipments and maintaining accurate shipment records
* Identifying and communicating delays or issues, particularly during large installation projects
* Monitoring spare\-parts inventory across multiple locations
* Supporting the coordination and follow\-up of service requests and machine breakdowns
* Communicating timelines, status updates and open items to retail partners
* Supporting projects such as store rollouts, machine exchanges, upgrades and process improvements
* Maintaining operational systems and databases and ensuring that information is accurate and up to date
* Performing basic technical troubleshooting when needed
* Visiting our warehouse facilities in the Chicago suburbs when hands\-on support is required
* Prior technical training is not required. We will make sure you receive the necessary training to support our machines and retail partners.

**What we are looking for**


You are organized, dependable and comfortable managing several tasks at the same time. You take ownership, follow through and enjoy helping both customers and colleagues find practical solutions.


We imagine that you:

* Have experience from a coordinating, customer\-facing or operational role
* Are comfortable handling recurring tasks while keeping track of changing priorities and projects
* Communicate clearly and professionally with customers, partners, vendors and colleagues
* Have strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Are confident using Microsoft Office and comfortable learning new ERP systems and databases
* Work well independently while also being a supportive team player
* Have a positive, flexible and solution\-oriented mindset
* Are willing to learn basic technical support tasks and take a hands\-on approach when needed
* Experience with inventory management, equipment tracking, process improvement or basic technical support is an advantage, but not a requirement.

**Why join IMBOX?**


IMBOX is in an exciting phase of expansion across North America. As our installed base grows, reliable service and smooth operational coordination are becoming increasingly important to the success of our retail partners and commercial teams.


You will join a collaborative environment with short decision\-making paths and the opportunity to influence how we work as the organization develops. Your contribution will help keep installations, service activities and partner communication moving forward as we scale.


This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys structure, variety and being close to the day\-to\-day operations of a growing international company.


Practical details

**Location: Chicago, Illinois**


Employment: Full\-time


Working hours: Standard 40\-hour workweek, typically 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m., with flexible scheduling opportunities


Travel: Occasional travel at short notice may be required, limited to approximately 50 days per year


Reporting to: Head of Operations


Direct reports: None

**About IMBOX**


At Imbox Protection, you're not just joining a company, you're becoming part of a fast\-moving scale\-up where ideas quickly become reality and your work has a visible impact from day one. We operate in a dynamic environment where growth is constant and change is embraced.


Imbox Protection is a global leader in automated protection solutions for footwear and apparel retail. Backed by a leading private equity fund, Imbox is on an ambitious international growth journey with operations in more than 40 markets worldwide.


We value curiosity, collaboration, and ownership. In return, we offer an environment where learning happens fast, decisions are made close to the business, and everyone has the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution.

jobs.description:
Business Account Sales Representative — Corporate Transportation

**O’Hare Limo Services \| Chicago, IL**

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Industry:** Luxury Transportation / Ground Transportation  
**Experience Level:** Sales experience preferred, especially B2B, hospitality, transportation, travel, or account management

About O’Hare Limo Services

O’Hare Limo Services has been proudly serving Chicago and the Chicagoland suburbs for **over 35 years**. Located on Foster Avenue near the Rosemont Fashion Outlet Mall, we specialize in professional, reliable transportation to and from **O’Hare International Airport**, as well as corporate and private transportation throughout the Chicago area.

We are looking for an ambitious, relationship\-focused **Business Account Sales Representative** to help expand our growing corporate client base.

This is an opportunity for a motivated sales professional who enjoys prospecting, building relationships, negotiating business agreements, and turning new clients into long\-term accounts.

The Opportunity

As a Business Account Sales Representative, your primary goal will be to **prospect, pitch, and secure corporate transportation accounts** that generate recurring business.

You will work directly with businesses, hotels, corporate travel managers, executive assistants, office managers, and other decision\-makers who regularly arrange transportation for employees, executives, clients, and guests.

The ideal candidate is comfortable making outbound calls, developing their own leads, conducting face\-to\-face or virtual sales meetings, negotiating customized corporate rates, and managing relationships after the sale.

Key ResponsibilitiesBusiness Development \& Lead Generation

* Proactively identify and prospect new corporate accounts throughout Chicago and the Chicagoland area.
* Conduct outbound sales calls, emails, networking, and in\-person outreach.
* Develop relationships with hotels, corporate offices, travel managers, executive assistants, event planners, and local businesses.
* Generate new business rather than relying solely on inbound quote requests.
* Research prospective companies and identify transportation needs and decision\-makers.
* Schedule and conduct sales presentations and account meetings.

Corporate Account Onboarding

* Present O’Hare Limo Services’ transportation solutions to prospective clients.
* Develop customized corporate rate sheets based on client transportation needs.
* Guide new accounts through the onboarding process.
* Assist corporate clients with establishing pre\-saved passenger and profile databases.
* Set up centralized billing and recurring account procedures.
* Coordinate account information and preferences with our operations team.
* Utilize transportation management and reservation platforms such as **Limo Anywhere**.

Account Management \& Retention

* Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned corporate accounts.
* Build long\-term relationships with travel coordinators, executive assistants, office managers, and other key contacts.
* Monitor account activity and identify opportunities for additional business.
* Follow up with clients to encourage repeat and recurring bookings.
* Resolve customer concerns professionally and coordinate with operations when necessary.
* Maintain accurate account information and sales activity.

Revenue Growth \& Upselling

* Introduce clients to our range of luxury transportation options, including:
* Luxury sedans
* SUVs
* Executive vans
* Identify opportunities to expand existing accounts.
* Encourage clients to consolidate transportation needs with O’Hare Limo Services.
* Develop recurring corporate transportation programs and preferred\-vendor relationships.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

* Highly motivated and results\-oriented.
* Comfortable with outbound prospecting and cold calling.
* Confident communicating with business owners and corporate decision\-makers.
* Professional, personable, and relationship\-focused.
* Organized and capable of managing multiple accounts and sales opportunities.
* Comfortable negotiating rates and business agreements.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently.
* Persistent without being overly aggressive.
* Comfortable using CRM, sales, email, and computer\-based systems.
* Experienced in B2B sales, account management, hospitality, transportation, travel, or a related industry is a plus.

**Previous limousine or transportation\-industry experience is helpful, but not required for the right sales professional.**

Compensation

**Competitive base compensation \+ commission/incentive structure**

Compensation will vary based on experience, sales performance, and the commission structure established for the position.

We are interested in speaking with experienced sales professionals who are motivated by the opportunity to build a substantial book of recurring corporate business.

Why Join O’Hare Limo Services?

* **35\+ years in business**
* Established Chicago\-area transportation company
* Strong focus on corporate and airport transportation
* Opportunity to develop long\-term B2B accounts
* Established luxury vehicle fleet
* Chicago and Chicagoland market
* Located conveniently on Foster Avenue near the Rosemont Fashion Outlet Mall
* Opportunity to build recurring revenue through corporate accounts
* Work with businesses, hotels, executives, travel professionals, and other established organizations

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

This position is particularly well suited for a salesperson who understands that **the sale doesn't end when the contract is signed**.

Successful candidates will enjoy developing relationships, staying in touch with clients, finding new opportunities within existing accounts, and building a pipeline of recurring corporate transportation business.

The Regional Account Manager serves as the primary strategic liaison between CorVel and assigned customers, acting as an extension of the client organization. The role is responsible for client retention, revenue growth, service excellence, stewardship reporting, contract management, and identifying opportunities to expand CorVel services.



This position can be hybrid or remote.

* Manage regional accounts with at least $1M in annual revenue per account and portfolio exceeding $5M
* Drive revenue growth through expansion of existing accounts and introduction of additional CorVel services
* Build and maintain executive\-level client relationships
* Ensure client satisfaction, retention, and achievement of contractual services
* Oversee accounts receivable activities in partnership with operational leadership
* Lead client stewardship meetings and provide consultative guidance based on account trends and business needs
* Proactively raise concerns or potential issues to appropriate members of the management and executive team to remedy immediate concerns before they become issues; maintain an open items matrix to document all issues and resolution
* Coordinate account implementations, customer setups, and service delivery across internal teams
* Coordinate and attend customer meetings; ensure CorVel participants are engaged
* Discuss, understand, and meet agreed upon standards as mutually determined by CorVel and customer

PartsSource is the **leading technology and software platform for managing mission\-critical healthcare equipment**. Trusted by over 5,000 US hospitals and 15,000 clinical sites, PartsSource empowers providers and service organizations to maximize clinical availability for patient care and automates the procurement of parts, services and training through a unique digital experience.

  

PartsSource team members are deeply committed to our mission of **Ensuring Healthcare is Always On®**, which is foundational to our success and growth. Our vibrant culture is built upon aligned values, shared ownership, mutual respect, and a passion for collaborating to solve complex customer problems.



About the Job Opportunity



  

The Program Manager owns end\-to\-end delivery of PartsSource's largest and most complex customer programs across enterprise health systems, IDNs, and multi\-site organizations. You lead a matrixed project team spanning Engagement Managers, Implementation Specialists, technical resources, third\-party partners, and cross\-functional teams, holding them accountable to a comprehensive plan.

Build and maintain a single master program plan spanning every in\-scope workstream, with defined critical path, sequencing logic, and explicit dependency mapping. Determine the right implementation sequence and identify which workstreams gate others, where parallel execution is safe, and where phasing protects customer stability. Set the program\-level milestone framework and hold each workstream lead accountable to it, escalating slippage before it consumes float. Direct Engagement Managers, Implementation Specialists, and technical resources without formal authority, establishing clear ownership at the workstream level.

Own the master statement of work and its relationship to subordinate SOWs, service descriptions, joinders, and site\-level addenda. Present program scope, structure, assumptions, and dependencies to customer executives for alignment and sign\-off. Size total program effort across workstreams, surface resourcing gaps early, and negotiate capacity. Manage change at the program level by assessing downstream impact of every change request on other workstreams, cost, and go live.



Establish Executive Governance \& Stakeholder Relationships



Design and run the governance model including workstream sessions, program\-level integration cadences, and an executive Steering Committee at the C\-suite level. Manage Program Risk, Integrations \& Third Parties

Coordinate data feeds, interfaces, asset migration, and ERP connections across technical teams and customer IT. Own relationships and delivery dates for OEMs, service providers, vendors, and multi\-party delivery structures. Sequence onsite activity across multiple facilities and geographies, including inventories, deployments, and go live support.



Drive Adoption \& Benefits Realization



Lead change management for multi\-solution implementations. Set measurable criteria for each workstream and program overall; validate adoption and confirm benefits realization before closure. Hold accountability for the program's Customer Onboarding Index (COI) result against the 85%\+ standard. Lead the In\-Market Support phase through a clean transition to Services and Customer Success. Partner Across the Organization \& Advance the Practice

Description:

United American Indian Involvement (UAII) is the only Native American led non\-profit organization in Los Angeles County, proudly serving as a home for American Indian and Alaska Native communities. Through our healthcare facility and culturally centered programs, we provide essential physical, behavioral, and spiritual health services—helping individuals stay connected to their Tribal heritage and traditions.


For over 50 years, UAII has grown to become the largest nonprofit provider of health and human services for American Indians and Alaska Natives in Los Angeles, home to the nation’s largest Urban Indian population. Our dedicated team delivers compassionate care that supports daily healing, resilience, and the continued strength of our communities. UAII is committed to uphold Indigenous values in all aspects of our work. It guides our actions, relationships, and responsibilities, ensuring that we serve our communities with integrity, respect, and accountability.

**Core Principles**

* Respect for Relatives – I will honor the dignity of all people, recognizing that every individual is a relative deserving of respect, compassion, and care.
* Community Responsibility – My work is not only for individual benefit but for the collective well\-being of our communities, present and future.
* Cultural Integrity \- I will safeguard and uplift Indigenous languages, traditions, and cultural practices, ensuring they remain central to our organizational life.
* Reciprocity \- We give back in balance with what we receive, fostering mutual trust and accountability in all relationships.
* Stewardship – I will act as a caretaker of our communities, resources, and environment, mindful of the impact of our decisions on future generations.
* Truth and Transparency – I will communicate honestly and openly, ensuring clarity in our commitments and accountability in our actions

**The Domestic Violence Program Coordinator is a grant funded position.**

  



**Position Summary**


The Domestic Violence Program Coordinator is responsible for the development, coordination, and implementation of culturally responsive domestic violence prevention, advocacy, outreach, education, and training services for American Indian and Alaska Native individuals and families. This position provides trauma\-informed support, facilitates community engagement and awareness activities, conducts trainings and educational presentations, and collaborates with Tribal representatives, child welfare agencies, courts, and community partners to promote survivor safety, family stability, and positive outcomes for Native families. The Domestic Violence Program Coordinator supports compliance with the Indian Child Welfare Act (ICWA), attends dependency and related court hearings, assists with resource navigation and referrals, maintains program documentation and reporting requirements, and represents UAII in community meetings, coalitions, and outreach events while upholding the organization's mission, values, and commitment to preserving and strengthening Native families and communities.


Requirements:
* Provide peer support and mentorship to families involved in Indian Child Welfare cases and case involving domestic violence and/or sexual assault.
* Assist clients in understanding and navigating the Department of Social Services, court system, and domestic violence/sexual assault proceedings.
* Advocate for the best interests of domestic violence and sexual assault survivors.
* Provide support services within UAII or provide referrals as needed for domestic violence/sexual assault offenders.
* Work collaboratively with Child and Family Services staff, tribal representatives, and community partners to support client safety, family preservation, and cultural connections.
* Facilitate access to resources, services, and educational opportunities tailored to the unique needs of Native individuals and families.
* Document case activities and maintain clear, accurate records in accordance with organizational policies.
* Serve as the intake and referral specialist for new clients seeking DV/SA support.
* Coordinate and manage referrals to DV/SA support services and the Healthcare Division, ensuring clients remain connected to resources that support their wellness goals.
* Answer and triage incoming calls across the organization, directing individuals to the appropriate programs and staff.
* Attend court hearings as the designated representative for UAII, ensuring the organization’s interests and documentation are accurately presented.
* Coordinate domestic violence prevention and advocacy activities.
* Conduct community outreach, engagement, and awareness events.
* Develop and facilitate training and workshops.
* Attend court hearings related to ICWA and domestic violence/sexual assault matters.
* Collaborate with Tribal representatives, DCFS, attorneys, courts, and community partners.
* Assist with safety planning, referrals, and client advocacy.
* Maintain accurate documentation, reports, and program records.
* Participate in community coalitions and multidisciplinary meetings.
* Prepare reports and support grant requirements.
* Must be able to reliably travel between our Los Angeles office and assigned court hearings.
* Must be able to occasionally work evenings, and weekends as needed for Company events.
* Strong communication skills and ability to provide empathetic, culturally informed support to peers.
* Commitment to upholding the values and traditions of Native communities.
* Commitment to upholding the Mission and Vision of United American Indian Involvement.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Qualifications and Skills**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Associate degree in social work, Human Services, Child Development, or a related field; or a comparable combination of education, professional experience, and/or relevant lived experience supporting domestic violence, sexual assault survivors.

Avid Brands Ltd. Is currently seeking a Business Development Representative to join our amazing Sales Department. The BDR is responsible for identifying, developing, and closing new business opportunities for The Avid Group across the US.
This is an outbound focused sales role for someone who is curious, commercially minded, persistent, and comfortable building relationships from the ground up. The BDR researches target accounts, identifies the right decision makers, creates thoughtful outreach strategies, opens new conversations, and develops those opportunities into new customers.



The BDR owns the new business relationship from initial prospecting through close, working closely with Avid’s Strategic Account Managers to develop product solutions, pricing, proposals, and programs that meet the needs of prospective clients.



Working under the Head of Growth \& Partnerships, the BDR plays a critical role in Avid’s growth engine. Success is measured not simply by outreach activity, but by building a strong pipeline, converting qualified opportunities, and consistently bringing high\-quality new business into Avid.

**Core Responsibilities**

**New Business Development \& Prospecting**

* Research target companies, brands, retailers, and decision makers to identify relevant opportunities.

* Consistently generate new conversations, meetings, and qualified opportunities.

 **Opportunity Development \& Closing**

* Own new business opportunities from initial outreach through qualification, development, proposal, negotiation, and close.

* Qualify opportunities based on strategic fit, revenue potential, timing, and Avid’s ability to execute successfully.
* Clearly articulate Avid’s capabilities across creative, product development, sourcing, production, fulfillment, and retail programs.
* Partner closely with Strategic Account Managers to develop product recommendations, pricing, presentations, samples, and proposals that move opportunities forward.

new_jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**About Circadia Health**



Circadia Health is a growth\-stage healthcare AI company on a mission to prevent avoidable hospitalizations and transform senior\-care operations. Our Circadia Intelligence Platform combines:


* Contactless sensing that monitors respiration and motion with medical\-grade accuracy
* Native predictive models that detect 85% of preventable adverse events several days in advance
* Enterprise integrations that operationalize predictions directly inside EHR, care\-coordination, billing, and compliance workflows

Today, our technology touches 40,000\+ post\-acute patients daily across skilled\-nursing, home\-health, and home\-care networks. We are backed by leading healthcare and AI investors and headquartered in El Segundo, CA.

**What You'll Do**
------------------


**Implementation and Support**


* Lead on\-site implementation of Circadia's monitoring platform in SNFs, from device installation through go\-live, integrating it into existing care routines rather than adding a parallel process.
* Assess each facility before rollout: shift patterns, unit layout, staffing model, EHR workflow, and connectivity constraints.
* Build and execute the facility implementation plan with clear owners, dates, and dependencies, keeping it current as conditions change.
* Serve as first\-line support after launch: troubleshoot devices and connectivity, resolve staff questions, and escalate product issues with enough detail for Engineering to act.
* Track device uptime and utilization by facility, unit, and shift, and flag gaps before the customer does.


**Training and Adoption**


* Deliver training to clinical and frontline staff across all shifts, including nights and weekends, where adoption gaps usually live.
* Tailor content and delivery to the audience. CNAs, nurses, DONs, unit managers, and facility IT each need a different version.
* Build and maintain training materials and a knowledge base that hold up after you leave the building.
* Identify the behavioral reason adoption is lagging rather than defaulting to another session, and retrain where retraining is the actual fix.
* Develop facility champions and super\-users so competence survives staff turnover.


**Relationship Management and Collaboration**


* Build working trust with facility teams at every level, from the floor to the administrator, so staff surface issues early.
* Coordinate with in\-house care teams and remote clinical providers so the customer experiences one program, not several.
* Participate in interdisciplinary team meetings, contributing implementation insight and ensuring device data is used inside patient care plans.
* Partner with Customer Success, Clinical, Support, and Engineering to unblock deployments, and own customer\-facing communication while a dependency is open.
* Hand off to Customer Success with a documented account state: utilization baseline, stakeholder map, and open risks.


**Quality Improvement and Compliance**


* Feed field evidence to Product and Engineering: failure modes, workflow friction, and what staff actually do with the product.
* Ensure all activity complies with regulatory standards and patient safety guidelines.
* Maintain accurate documentation of implementation activity, staff education, and device functionality checks, aligned to organizational and regulatory requirements.
* Follow facility protocols on HIPAA, infection control, and site access.

**Qualifications**
------------------



**Must\-have**


* Bachelor's degree in business, operations, healthcare administration, nursing, or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience in a healthcare setting.
* Comfort operating inside healthcare environments, particularly skilled nursing facilities, with working knowledge of nursing workflows, shift structure, and floor dynamics.
* Clear, confident verbal and written communication with the ability to train and hold a room of clinical staff.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build credibility quickly with audiences ranging from CNAs to facility administrators.
* Practical problem\-solving: you diagnose the cause on site rather than escalating it as\-is.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, managing your own schedule, follow\-up, and commitments across multiple facilities at once.
* Organizational rigor with project tracking tools such as Monday.com. Nothing lives only in your head.
* Willingness to travel up to 75%, including early mornings and occasional overnight shift coverage.


**Preferred**


* Experience implementing healthcare technology, remote patient monitoring, or telehealth services in provider settings.
* Clinical background or license (RN, LPN, RT, CNA) or direct post\-acute operations experience.
* Experience training frontline staff in high\-turnover environments.


As a full\-time **Implementation Specialist,** you will be employed by Circadia Health, Inc. The anticipated annual base salary range for this full\-time position is $75,000 \- $100,000\. The base range is determined by role and level, and placement within the range will depend on a number of job\-related factors, including but not limited to your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.



Annual salary is only one part of an employee's total compensation package at Circadia Health. We also offer:


* Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k)
* Competitive time off with pay policies including vacation, sick days, and company holidays
* Impact: your work will influence care decisions for tens of thousands of seniors every day.
* Culture: hard\-working, mission\-driven, and collaborative — with weekly and monthly social events like yoga, beach bonfires, and Wednesday/Friday team lunches.

**Ionblade — Entry\-Level Sales Development Representative (SDR)**

**Location**: 133 N. Altadena Drive, Pasadena, CA 91107

**Work arrangement**: Full\-time, in\-office at hire; hybrid work may be considered after one year based on sustained performance, reliability, business needs, and company policy

**Employment type**: Hourly, nonexempt, full\-time

**Schedule**: Monday–Friday; assigned schedule of either 6:00 AM–2:30 PM or 7:00 AM–3:30 PM, including a 30\-minute unpaid, off\-duty meal period

**Pay**: $28\.50 per hour, plus uncapped monthly new\-account commission

**Target commute area**: Candidates must currently live within 15 miles of 133 N. Altadena Drive, Pasadena, CA 91107, or be able to reliably commute to the office from within that distance by their start date.

**About Ionblade**

Ionblade provides web hosting business services supported by a consultative, high\-activity sales process. We are hiring two Entry\-Level Sales Development Representatives to help prospective customers understand and select qualifying Ionblade services.

This is an excellent starting sales role for a reliable, coachable, competitive person who communicates clearly, handles rejection professionally, and wants a real path into Account Executive or sales\-management responsibility. Prior sales experience and a college degree are not required. We will train the right person.

**The Role**

As an Entry\-Level SDR, you will work from Ionblade\-provided leads, make a high volume of outbound calls, qualify prospective customers, and close lower\-complexity opportunities. You will use 8x8, WHMCS, Google Workspace, and Ionblade sales processes to accurately record activity and move opportunities forward. Some larger or more complex opportunities will be passed to an Account Executive or manager. You may still receive account credit when you originated or qualified the opportunity, subject to CRM attribution and Ionblade’s commission policy. This is an in\-office role at the start. It is designed for someone who wants consistent coaching, structured training, clear expectations, and advancement based on results.

**What You’ll Do**

 Make approximately 200 outbound call attempts per business day, averaged across the workweek

 Build toward approximately 2–3 hours of valid customer conversation time per day; talk time is used as a coaching and reporting metric, not as a standalone hard quota

 Contact and follow up with Ionblade\-provided leads using professional, clear, customer\-focused communication

 Learn customer needs, qualify opportunities, and recommend appropriate lower\-complexity Ionblade services

 Close qualifying sales and help new customers complete payment and service activation

 Accurately document calls, customer needs, next steps, sales activity, lead ownership, and

outcomes in company systems

 Use 8x8, WHMCS, Google Workspace, and other Ionblade tools as assigned

 Route larger, technical, or complex sales opportunities to an Account Executive or manager while preserving accurate CRM attribution

 Participate in coaching, call reviews, role\-play, product training, and team meetings

 Maintain reliable attendance, punctuality, professional conduct, and consistent follow\-through

 Follow all company sales, privacy, data\-security, and customer\-communication procedures

**What Success Looks Like**

After the initial 30–60\-day ramp period, successful SDRs generally:

 Maintain consistent, well\-documented outbound activity

 Build productive customer conversation time and high\-quality follow\-up habits

 Demonstrate strong call quality, reliability, CRM discipline, and coachability

 Work toward 20 or more credited new paying customer accounts per month

 Escalate the right opportunities while retaining accurate lead and account ownership records

 Treat prospects and customers professionally, even when a conversation does not lead to a sale

**Qualifications Required**

 Ability to work full\-time, in person, at Ionblade’s Pasadena office

 Current residence within 15 miles of 133 N. Altadena Drive, Pasadena, CA 91107, or ability to reliably commute from within that distance by the start date

 Strong verbal communication skills and clear professional writing

 Comfort making a high volume of outbound calls and hearing “no” without losing focus or professionalism

 Reliability, punctuality, resilience, competitiveness, and willingness to learn from coaching

 Basic comfort using browser\-based business software, email, calendars, and spreadsheets

 Ability to organize follow\-up tasks and keep accurate notes

 Authorization to work in the United States Preferred, Not Required

 Sales, customer service, call\-center, retail, appointment\-setting, hospitality, or service\-industry experience

 Familiarity with CRM, ticketing, VoIP, hosting, SaaS, IT, web, or technical\-service environments

 College coursework or degree No prior sales experience is required. We value potential, work ethic, communication, and coachability.

**Compensation**

Base Pay

 $28\.50 per hour

 Full\-time, nonexempt position

 40 paid working hours per week, excluding the 30\-minute unpaid meal period each workday

 Overtime eligibility and payment in accordance with applicable law

 Approximate annual base pay at 40 hours per week: $59,280 before overtime and commissions

**Monthly New\-Account Commission**

After successful completion of the four\-week training period, SDRs may earn uncapped monthly commission for credited new paying customer accounts:

Credited new accounts in a calendar month Commission rate

0–19 No new\-account commission

20–29 $35 for each credited new account that month

30 or more $40 for each credited new account that month

A credited new account is a new customer account for a qualifying Ionblade service for which payment has successfully cleared and the service has activated.

An SDR may receive account credit when they originated or qualified

Our social media channels are a major part of how guests discover our events, learn to trust our brands, get excited about upcoming cruises, and stay connected to our community.

The Role

We are looking for a creative, highly engaged Social Media Content \& Community Coordinator who can help turn our social media pages into destinations our guests and music fans want to visit every day. The primary focus is creating, finding, scheduling, and publishing engaging content while actively managing our online communities. This is not primarily a customer\-service or comment\-response position.

You should constantly be asking: “What can we post today that our guests and music fans will find interesting, useful, exciting, or worth sharing?”

Content may include artist news, birthdays, new music releases, throwback performances, cruise memories, videos, polls, event announcements, theme nights, travel information, registration reminders, behind\-the\-scenes content, artist spotlights, countdowns, carousels, and other creative ideas.

Our Social Communities

Public Event \& Brand Pages

These pages introduce people to our events and showcase the excitement, credibility, artists, guests, and experiences behind each cruise. Content should attract new followers while keeping existing fans engaged and excited about our brands.

Guest Cruise Groups

These communities are primarily for guests preparing to sail. Content should keep guests informed and excited with important deadlines, travel information, theme nights, registration instructions, entertainment updates, things to know before sailing, and other useful cruise information.

*Understanding the difference between these audiences \- and creating appropriate content for each \- is a major part of the position.*

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain an active content calendar across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and our different event communities.• Research and identify fresh, relevant content involving our artists, music genres, events, and guest interests.• Write engaging social copy that is natural, exciting, accurate, and consistent with each brand.• Create and schedule posts, carousels, photos, videos, polls, announcements, and other engaging content.• Keep public event pages active and interesting even when we are not making major company announcements.• Keep sailing guests informed about deadlines, registration, theme nights, travel requirements, special events, schedule information, and other important cruise updates.• Work closely with our email content/marketing team so important guest communications are coordinated across email and social media.• Use Meta Business Suite, Hootsuite, or similar platforms to efficiently manage multiple brands, pages, groups, comments, and messages.• Monitor Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and other channels for important conversations, trends, complaints, misinformation, or developing issues.• Engage with our communities and help maintain a positive, active environment.• Use our chatbot and approved information resources to help answer appropriate guest questions.• Coordinate with team members who handle routine questions and responses rather than personally answering every basic inquiry.• Identify sales opportunities and route them to the appropriate sales team member.• Escalate customer\-service issues, complaints, payment questions, booking problems, or other situations to the appropriate department.• Recognize issues developing within a community and alert management quickly when something requires attention.• Track engagement and identify what types of content perform well so we can continuously improve our social strategy.

What We’re Looking For

* Strong social media content creation experience \- not simply customer service experience.• Excellent writing skills and the ability to create engaging, conversational social content.• Hands\-on experience managing Facebook and Instagram pages and groups; TikTok experience is strongly preferred.• Working knowledge of Meta Business Suite, Hootsuite, or comparable social media management platforms.• Ability to manage multiple brands and communities without confusing messaging or audiences.• Strong creative instincts and the ability to continually find new content ideas without waiting to be assigned every post.• Comfort researching artists, music news, trends, anniversaries, releases, birthdays, and other relevant content opportunities.• Ability to create effective social posts and carousels and work with our creative team when graphics or video assets are needed.• Strong organizational skills and the ability to coordinate content with email, marketing, sales, guest services, and operations.• Good judgment about when to engage directly, when to use approved information, and when an issue needs to be escalated.• Experience in music, entertainment, events, travel, hospitality, or cruise\-related businesses is a plus.

The Person Who Will Succeed Here

We want someone who loves social media and naturally looks for reasons to post and engage. We want someone who comes to us with ideas \- not someone waiting for management to hand them every post.

The right person understands that social media is not simply a place to answer questions or post advertisements. It is where we build relationships with guests, showcase our events, celebrate the music and artists our guests love, provide important information, and create communities people want to be part of.

Schedule \& Benefits

This is a full\-time, in\-office position based in our Newport Beach office. Some cruises, launches, and events require scheduled evening, weekend, or travel work. Hours worked during those assignments are recorded and paid in accordance with applicable law.

USA Ninja Challenge Dublin is looking for dependable, energetic full\-time coaches who want to make a lasting impact on children.

Our coaches help kids develop strength, coordination, confidence, resilience, and the courage to keep trying when something is difficult. We’re looking for people who enjoy that work and want to help build a strong program for our athletes and families.

The **Operations Coordinator** plays a vital role in supporting maintenance operations. By streamlining processes and ensuring timely communication with residents and vendors, this role is essential to keeping a portfolio of properties running efficiently and effectively. * Schedule pre\-move\-out and final move\-out inspections with residents, which may be conducted in person or virtually as needs demand.
* Create purchase orders for vendor services and track vendor\-related work orders.

Berkeley Repertory Theatre (Berkeley Rep) has grown from a storefront stage to an international leader in innovative theatre. * An appreciation for the performing arts.
