new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

new_jobs.title: Social Media Manager
new_jobs.description:
Hawksmoor is a British steakhouse group, currently ranked No. 2 in the world among multi\-site steakhouse groups by the World's 101 Best Steak Restaurants awards. We have three restaurants in the US: New York, Boston and Chicago, and this role owns the organic social media strategy across all of them, working alongside our Senior Group Content and Social Strategy Lead.


Our growth in the US rests on the same obsession that built the brand in the UK: real sourcing, real cooking, and a genuine point of view, carried through everything from the menu to the media we put out. This role is responsible for turning that into a considered, confident organic social strategy that builds Hawksmoor's reputation across three major US markets, and then for executing it hands\-on, building the strategy and creating the content that brings it to life, in close partnership with our UK\-based brand marketing team.


Key Responsibilities:

*Strategy \& Planning*

* Collaborate with the Senior Group Content and Social Strategy Lead to develop and present the U.S. organic social media strategy in line with Hawksmoor’s business objectives and marketing calendar.
* Create and maintain monthly and quarterly social media plans for U.S. restaurants, aligned with wider business activity and culturally relevant moments.
* Act as the primary lead for Hawksmoor’s social media presence in the U.S., while working closely with the broader marketing team to ensure consistency of tone and brand messaging across regions.
* Build and present the US organic social strategy with the Group Senior Content Manager, tying every plan back to Hawksmoor's business objectives and marketing calendar.
* Turn brand plans and business goals into monthly and quarterly social plans for all three US restaurants, timed to wider business activity and moments that actually matter to our audience.
* Own the US social presence day to day, working with the wider marketing team to keep tone and message consistent across the UK and US.

*Content \& Scheduling*

* Manage day\-to\-day channel activity, including community management, across all platforms for the US market
* Ensure cohesion between social media activity and wider marketing channels
* Proactively introduce creative social campaigns tied to brand activity, business objectives and cultural moments
* Brief and collaborate with internal teams and external partners as required
* Educate and upskill the wider marketing team on social media trends and platform best practice
* Know which content works on which platform for which audience, and plan accordingly rather than posting the same thing everywhere.
* Plan and schedule daily activity so campaigns land on time and stay relevant.

*Community \& Engagement*

* Build genuine community, not just reply to comments and DMs on time, though that matters too. The goal is people who follow because they feel part of something.
* Build relationships with local influencers, creators and partners who fit the brand, to extend reach in each city.
* Spot opportunities for co\-creation, user\-generated content and local partnerships.

*Insights \& Performance*

* Track performance and use the data to sharpen content, not just to report on it.
* Report regularly on activity and results, and use what you learn to adjust strategy.
* Stay ahead of platform and algorithm changes, and know what's worth acting on versus what's just noise.


Requirements:

* 3–5 years' proven experience managing social media across multiple channels and content types, ideally in hospitality, food \& beverage, lifestyle or another premium, consumer\-facing brand.
* Hands\-on, proven experience managing Facebook, Instagram, TikTok end\-to\-end with a track record of managing high\-volume channels with large followings.
* A track record of turning brand plans and business objectives into organic social strategy that actually delivers.
* Real platform and audience expertise: you know what content works on which platform for which audience
* Exceptional attention to detail, the kind that shows up in every caption, crop and post time.
* A quality\-first instinct rather than a trend\-chasing one. Our guest is 35\+ and discerning; we want someone who can build content with real craft and restraint, not something that only works because it's this week's trend.
* Experience building community and engagement, not just managing it. Growing genuine audience connection rather than just responding to comments and messages.
* Sharp instincts for algorithm shifts, platform changes and emerging opportunities, and the initiative to act on them early.
* Content / asset creation skills a bonus but not necessity (Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, CapCut or similar).
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with real command of tone and brand voice.
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced environment with shifting priorities, which is normal in hospitality, and able to reprioritize without losing quality.
* Highly organized, confident managing your own timeline across time zones with the UK team.
* Pride in the work: every post represents the whole restaurant, and you treat it that way.
* Willingness to travel semi\-regularly between New York, Boston and Chicago.

Vega is the premier AI\-native claims TPA built to replace that entire stack. Our team is equal parts experienced insurance operators and modern technologists. * Partner with leadership and our Account Executives to refine messaging, test what works, and sharpen our sales playbook
* Optimize your workflow and tooling to get the most out of every hour

**Who You Are**

* You prioritize speed and action, above all else, and see rejection as opportunity
* Genuinely curious about AI and how it reshapes traditional industries, and able to explain complex AI value propositions clearly and confidently to senior insurance executives
* You think in systems and thrive on high\-volume outbound in a fast\-growing startup

Join Brightree as a Customer Success Manager and become a trusted advisor to healthcare providers who rely on our solutions to streamline operations and focus on delivering exceptional patient care. * Ability to travel domestically up to 20\-30%.

* Experience in a Customer Success or Account Management role supporting strategic customer relationships.
* Experience managing and resolving customer escalations for large, regional, or multi\-product accounts.

At ResMed, our mission is to help people live healthier, higher\-quality lives through innovative healthcare technology. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now! We commit to respond to every applicant.

At Northwestern Medicine, every patient interaction makes a difference in cultivating a positive workplace. This patient\-first approach is what sets us apart as a leader in the healthcare industry. As an integral part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to join our quest for better health care, no matter where you work within the Northwestern Medicine system. We pride ourselves on providing competitive benefits: from tuition reimbursement and loan forgiveness to 401(k) matching and lifecycle benefits, our goal is to take care of our employees. Ready to join our quest for better?

 **Job Description**  

The **Program Coordinator, Operations** reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.


The Program Coordinator, Operations is responsible for supporting the NMG Operations department and participating in initiatives to enhance ambulatory operations. The Program Coordinator supports teams in achieving health system, regional, and local priorities and goals.

**Responsibilities:**

* Systematically support any and all initiatives that fall within the NMG Operations department
* Provides program coordination and program management including planning, decision making and implementation for select projects.
* Coordinates, on a daily basis, the planning, resource allocation, information distribution and overall performance reporting for the assigned projects.
* Applies standard project management methodologies for project lifecycle of analysis, design, implementation, verification as well as value measurement definition.
* Establishes and maintain effective communications regarding project status with the team members and other organizational reporting structures.
* Works with project teams to manage schedule and scope.
* Assists with creation and preparation of materials which are presented to management and board\-level committees and subcommittees, particularly power point presentations and printed materials.
* Utilizes advanced Microsoft Office applications to design and lay\-out presentations and reports.
* Participates in meetings, accounts for meeting discussion and next steps and takes ownership of follow up items as appropriate.
* Follows up with department staff, to make sure deadlines are kept.
* Utilizes appropriate resources within the institution, division and department to manage and complete each assigned task and/or project.
* Participates in preparing program’s budget, creates and monitors budget statements, assists in designing reports.
* Researches and develops internal and external communications including presentations, speaking points, correspondence and other written materials.
* Communicates (verbal and written) with a wide range of departments, employees, vendors, and physicians; and serves as a liaison on behalf of the department leadership to foster strong working relationships.
* Represents the department, program or project with various level of personnel both internally and externally.
* Responds to unanticipated complex issues and manages critical and confidential information.
* Applies analytical skills, tools and techniques to improvement efforts.
* Collaborates with other system functions as required on training initiatives (e.g., IT, Quality, Analytics, Patient Experience, etc.).
* Provides calendar management support for the department; facilitates and schedules meetings, including logistics; helps set meeting priorities; communicates meeting objectives and helps identifies materials needed for meeting; distributes materials in advance of meeting as advised by leadership and exercises judgment to ensure appropriate parties attend meeting
* Participates in creating department’s targets, preparing job description, screening resumes.
* Overseas creation, design and maintenance of internal website content ensuring ease and practicality of use for targeted audience.
* Plans and executes the annual pre\-medicine internship cycle including position posting, candidate selection, site coordination and placement, seminar preparation, day\-to\-day supervision and other operational logistics.


Additional Functions:

* May support additional projects as requested.
* Other duties as assigned.

* Bachelors degree
* Minimum of 3 \- 5 years of relevant experience
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office package
* Ability to organize and think independently with orientation to deadline and detail
* Experience supporting more than one executive or manager.
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Flexible/adaptable – ability to work with diverse group of healthcare professionals in a matrix environment

**Preferred****:**

* Healthcare experience
* Experience with project management and analysis

  

**Additional Information**

 **Job Description**  

The **Administrative Coordinator** position reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.


The Administrative Coordinator is responsible for higher\-level administrative support to various directors within the organization and must use independent judgment and authority to execute projects and maintain workflow. The incumbent will work as part of team and demonstrate superior organization skills, strong interpersonal and communication skills, and attention to detail proficient Microsoft application skills (Word, Excel and PowerPoint) and be highly flexible and adaptable.

* Independently performs high level technical and administrative work supporting the division or unit.
* Serves as a project manager for a variety of special projects; conducts special studies and analyses and makes recommendations to resolve organizational, procedural and system problems.
* Creates and revises systems and procedures by analyzing operating practices, record\-keeping systems, forms control, supplies inventory, and office layout.
* Implements changes independently for areas of responsibility. For issues outside responsibility, makes recommendations and, following managerial review, implements changes.
* Uses organizational software applications to research and prepare documents and presentations. Collects, analyzes, and manage data.
* Manages calendar; sets meeting priorities; identifies objectives of meetings and identifies materials needed for meeting; exercises judgment to ensure appropriate parties attend meeting.
* Screens incoming email, mail and telephone calls to assign priority, route as needed, identify additional resources needed to address and/or respond to the communication.
* Independently plans and executes events, activities, and meetings.
* Assists with creation, preparation, and distribution of materials to be presented to all levels of organizational staff.
* Reads, researches, and routes correspondence while maintaining security and confidentiality of highly sensitive information.
* Authors responses on behalf of director or department
* Develops and maintains relationships with all internal and external customers including patients, providers, staff and vendors.
* Records meeting discussions by attending meetings and recording key discussions and conclusions.
* May perform other duties as assigned.

  

**Qualifications** **Required****:**

* Associates Degree or equivalent relevant (administrative) experience
* 3\-5 years’ experience in a business office with a strong emphasis on database management and customer service.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office, PowerPoint and Excel.

* Excellent interpersonal skills.

**Preferred****:**

* Bachelor of Arts degree or business equivalent.
* 5 years business experience.

At Monroe Truck Equipment, an Aebi Schmidt brand located in Joliet, IL, we pride ourselves on innovation, collaboration and dedication to excellence. new_jobs.title: Business Account Sales Representative — Corporate Transportation
new_jobs.description:
Business Account Sales Representative — Corporate Transportation

**O’Hare Limo Services \| Chicago, IL**

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Industry:** Luxury Transportation / Ground Transportation  
**Experience Level:** Sales experience preferred, especially B2B, hospitality, transportation, travel, or account management

About O’Hare Limo Services

O’Hare Limo Services has been proudly serving Chicago and the Chicagoland suburbs for **over 35 years**. Located on Foster Avenue near the Rosemont Fashion Outlet Mall, we specialize in professional, reliable transportation to and from **O’Hare International Airport**, as well as corporate and private transportation throughout the Chicago area.

We are looking for an ambitious, relationship\-focused **Business Account Sales Representative** to help expand our growing corporate client base.

This is an opportunity for a motivated sales professional who enjoys prospecting, building relationships, negotiating business agreements, and turning new clients into long\-term accounts.

The Opportunity

As a Business Account Sales Representative, your primary goal will be to **prospect, pitch, and secure corporate transportation accounts** that generate recurring business.

You will work directly with businesses, hotels, corporate travel managers, executive assistants, office managers, and other decision\-makers who regularly arrange transportation for employees, executives, clients, and guests.

The ideal candidate is comfortable making outbound calls, developing their own leads, conducting face\-to\-face or virtual sales meetings, negotiating customized corporate rates, and managing relationships after the sale.

Key ResponsibilitiesBusiness Development \& Lead Generation

* Proactively identify and prospect new corporate accounts throughout Chicago and the Chicagoland area.
* Conduct outbound sales calls, emails, networking, and in\-person outreach.
* Develop relationships with hotels, corporate offices, travel managers, executive assistants, event planners, and local businesses.
* Generate new business rather than relying solely on inbound quote requests.
* Research prospective companies and identify transportation needs and decision\-makers.
* Schedule and conduct sales presentations and account meetings.

Corporate Account Onboarding

* Present O’Hare Limo Services’ transportation solutions to prospective clients.
* Develop customized corporate rate sheets based on client transportation needs.
* Guide new accounts through the onboarding process.
* Assist corporate clients with establishing pre\-saved passenger and profile databases.
* Set up centralized billing and recurring account procedures.
* Coordinate account information and preferences with our operations team.
* Utilize transportation management and reservation platforms such as **Limo Anywhere**.

Account Management \& Retention

* Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned corporate accounts.
* Build long\-term relationships with travel coordinators, executive assistants, office managers, and other key contacts.
* Monitor account activity and identify opportunities for additional business.
* Follow up with clients to encourage repeat and recurring bookings.
* Resolve customer concerns professionally and coordinate with operations when necessary.
* Maintain accurate account information and sales activity.

Revenue Growth \& Upselling

* Introduce clients to our range of luxury transportation options, including:
* Luxury sedans
* SUVs
* Executive vans
* Identify opportunities to expand existing accounts.
* Encourage clients to consolidate transportation needs with O’Hare Limo Services.
* Develop recurring corporate transportation programs and preferred\-vendor relationships.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

* Highly motivated and results\-oriented.
* Comfortable with outbound prospecting and cold calling.
* Confident communicating with business owners and corporate decision\-makers.
* Professional, personable, and relationship\-focused.
* Organized and capable of managing multiple accounts and sales opportunities.
* Comfortable negotiating rates and business agreements.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently.
* Persistent without being overly aggressive.
* Comfortable using CRM, sales, email, and computer\-based systems.
* Experienced in B2B sales, account management, hospitality, transportation, travel, or a related industry is a plus.

**Previous limousine or transportation\-industry experience is helpful, but not required for the right sales professional.**

Compensation

**Competitive base compensation \+ commission/incentive structure**

Compensation will vary based on experience, sales performance, and the commission structure established for the position.

We are interested in speaking with experienced sales professionals who are motivated by the opportunity to build a substantial book of recurring corporate business.

Why Join O’Hare Limo Services?

* **35\+ years in business**
* Established Chicago\-area transportation company
* Strong focus on corporate and airport transportation
* Opportunity to develop long\-term B2B accounts
* Established luxury vehicle fleet
* Chicago and Chicagoland market
* Located conveniently on Foster Avenue near the Rosemont Fashion Outlet Mall
* Opportunity to build recurring revenue through corporate accounts
* Work with businesses, hotels, executives, travel professionals, and other established organizations

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

This position is particularly well suited for a salesperson who understands that **the sale doesn't end when the contract is signed**.

Successful candidates will enjoy developing relationships, staying in touch with clients, finding new opportunities within existing accounts, and building a pipeline of recurring corporate transportation business.

new_jobs.title: Regional Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Regional Account Manager serves as the primary strategic liaison between CorVel and assigned customers, acting as an extension of the client organization. The role is responsible for client retention, revenue growth, service excellence, stewardship reporting, contract management, and identifying opportunities to expand CorVel services.



This position can be hybrid or remote.


**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS \& RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Manage regional accounts with at least $1M in annual revenue per account and portfolio exceeding $5M
* Drive revenue growth through expansion of existing accounts and introduction of additional CorVel services
* Build and maintain executive\-level client relationships
* Ensure client satisfaction, retention, and achievement of contractual services
* Oversee accounts receivable activities in partnership with operational leadership
* Lead client stewardship meetings and provide consultative guidance based on account trends and business needs
* Proactively raise concerns or potential issues to appropriate members of the management and executive team to remedy immediate concerns before they become issues; maintain an open items matrix to document all issues and resolution
* Coordinate account implementations, customer setups, and service delivery across internal teams
* Coordinate and attend customer meetings; ensure CorVel participants are engaged
* Discuss, understand, and meet agreed upon standards as mutually determined by CorVel and customer
* Develop/maintain account service instructions/communicate to service staff and post on the Intranet
* Manage contract renewals/price increases; coordinate with the AE and/or management team as appropriate
* Present information to assigned customers in an organized and persuasive fashion for contract renewals, service issue discussions, or additional product sales
* Regular attendance on the Monthly Account Manager Call
* Provide monthly account updates and document all new service opportunities in Salesforce.com
* Additional duties as assigned

  


**KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS:**


* Reliable professional with the ability to achieve balance between customer orientation and a results\-driven approach
* Knowledge of CorVel's services and completion of all CorVel Product Training Modules
* Business acumen with results\-oriented mindset
* Excellent presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
* Strong commitment to customer service
* Able to work independently while collaborating across departments
* Strong organizational, analytical, and time\-management abilities
* Must be proficient in Microsoft Office applications and CRM software (Salesforce)

  


**EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE:**


* Bachelor's degree, certification or equivalent experience in business, sales or marketing
* Proven experience in account management
* Experience in the insurance industry, managed care, worker’s compensation, or a related field

  


**PAY RANGE:**



CorVel uses a market based approach to pay and our salary ranges may vary depending on your location. Pay rates are established taking into account the following factors: federal, state, and local minimum wage requirements, the geographic location differential, job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal employee equity, and market conditions. Our ranges may be modified at any time.



For leveled roles (I, II, III, Senior, Lead, etc.) new hires may be slotted into a different level, either up or down, based on assessment during interview process taking into consideration experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role. The level may impact the salary range and these adjustments would be clarified during the offer process.



Pay Range: $83,494 – $139,002



A list of our benefit offerings can be found on our CorVel website: CorVel Careers \| Opportunities in Risk Management (https://www.corvel.com/company/careers/)



In general, our opportunities will be posted for up to 1 year from date of posting, or until we have selected candidate(s) to fulfill the opening, whichever comes first.

  


**ABOUT CORVEL:**



CorVel, a certified Great Place to Work® Company, is a national provider of industry\-leading risk management solutions for the workers’ compensation, auto, health and disability management industries. CorVel was founded in 1987 and has been publicly traded on the NASDAQ stock exchange since 1991\. Our continual investment in human capital and technology enable us to deliver the most innovative and integrated solutions to our clients. We are a stable and growing company with a strong, supportive culture and plenty of career advancement opportunities. Over 4,000 people working across the United States embrace our core values of Accountability, Commitment, Excellence, Integrity and Teamwork (ACE\-IT!).



A comprehensive benefits package is available for full\-time regular employees and includes Medical (HDHP) w/Pharmacy, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account Options, Life Insurance, Accident Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Pre\-paid Legal Insurance, Parking and Transit FSA accounts, 401K, ROTH 401K, and paid time off.


**CorVel is an Equal Opportunity Employer, drug free workplace, and complies with ADA regulations as applicable.**



\#LI\-Remote


Equal Opportunity Employer  

This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

new_jobs.title: Key Account Manager (Drayage)
new_jobs.description:
**Accelerate your career at RXO**  

RXO is a leading provider of transportation solutions. With cutting\-edge technology at the center, we're revolutionizing the industry with our massive network and commitment to finding solutions for every challenge. We create more efficient ways for shippers and carriers to transport goods across North America.


Compensation for this role is $45,000 \- $50,000 The role may also be eligible for bonus or commission pay. Actual compensation may vary due to factors such as experience and skill set.
As a Key Account Manager (Drayage) at RXO, you’ll serve as the primary point of contact and relationship manager for our most important **intermodal and drayage clients** , ensuring seamless execution across complex supply chains.


**What your day\-to\-day will look like:**

* Serve as an advocate and liaison for RXO’s top intermodal and drayage clients, ensuring consistent communication, visibility, and overall customer satisfaction
* Expand existing customer accounts through strategic relationship development and mode\-specific solutions
* Collaborate with operations, procurement, and carrier partners to secure competitive terms, including rate negotiations, capacity alignment, and specialized equipment needs (containers, chassis, rail, etc.)
* Maintain a strong understanding of intermodal and drayage networks, including port operations, rail providers, and inland distribution, to proactively meet client needs
* Manage shipments cradle\-to\-grave, ensuring execution, milestone tracking, and issue resolution across port, rail, and final\-mile delivery
* Ensure the integrity of each shipment and the RXO brand by following standard processes and best practices
* Update internal systems and tracking tools throughout the day to maintain accurate reporting, visibility, and performance metrics
* Monitor billing accuracy, accessorials, and cost controls to ensure efficient and mutually beneficial operations

**At a minimum, you’ll need:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent related work or military experience
* 1\+ year of professional experience

**It’d be great if you also have:**

* 5\+ years of experience in a transportation or logistics environment, preferably with intermodal and drayage exposure
* Strong understanding of port operations, rail networks, and containerized freight movement
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

**Does this sound like you? Check out what else RXO has to offer.**

**Why Join Us:**

**Our Benefits**

* Competitive pay
* Paid time off includes: up to 8 holidays, up to 2 floating Diversity Days, Hourly: Earn up to 13 days PTO/ Salary: Earn up to 15 days PTO, up to 40 hours bereavement leave, up to 16 hours volunteer time, jury duty, at least 2 weeks family bonding leave, up to 40 hours prenatal care leave
* 401(k) retirement plan with up to 5% company match
* Insurance: health, prescription, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life, short and long\-term disability, accidental death and personal loss, business travel, legal services, ID theft, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Tuition reimbursement, adoption assistance
* Tax\-Advantaged Accounts: Health Savings Account, Health Care Flexible Spending Account, Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, Commuter Spending Account
* Health Reimbursement Arrangement

**Our Culture**

Our values are the key to our unique culture and our ability to deliver for everyone we serve.


We do great things when we are inclusive and work together. To perform with excellence, we learn from one another, value diverse perspectives, operate safely and build strong relationships.


**The Next Step**  

Ready to join our team? We'd love to hear from you. Fill out an application now and join our talent community to learn about future opportunities. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. All applicants who receive a conditional offer of employment may be required to take and pass a pre\-employment drug test. The above statements are not an exhaustive list of all required responsibilities, duties, and skills for this job classification.

new_jobs.title: Operations Associate
new_jobs.description:
**Location:** Chicago, Illinois

Our CB2 associates create timeless products and unforgettable experiences, proudly serving customers with a focus on quality, design, and character. We believe that’s the secret to an effortlessly collected home. Our CB2 brand was established in 2002, and continues to evolve to deliver sophisticated, modern design for contemporary customers.


From archival pieces by design legends to contemporary cult classics, this is furniture and decor built to last. Ready to build a legacy? Join the creative minds at CB2 to create something unforgettable.



As a CB2 Operations Associate, you will play a vital role in maintaining an efficient stockroom and supporting the salesfloor. Reporting to the Assistant Store Leader, you’ll ensure timely customer order fulfillment, accurate inventory management, and well\-presented store displays. You will collaborate with the store team to uphold company policies, foster an inclusive environment, and maintain safety, while learning and utilizing all relevant systems to support operational routines, pricing, and promotions. A positive attitude, enthusiasm, and strong multitasking skills are essential for success in this fast\-paced role.
**A day in the life as an Operations Associate...**


* Assist the team with ensuring product and displays on the sales floor are stocked appropriately and available for customers to purchase
* Perform duties associated with receiving and processing incoming shipments. Process all incoming and outgoing packages, including customer curbside pick\-up orders, ship from store, buy online pickup in store, in a timely manner
* Assist in preparing the stockroom for inventory and perform assigned inventory duties
* Perform prompt and accurate stock checks, while maintaining an organized and efficient stockroom
* Greet and receive customers in a welcoming manner, respond to customer questions, and involve higher level management, as appropriate
* Maintain an awareness of loss prevention, security and safety following the guidelines provided by management or the Human Resources Department and/or as outlined in the Associate Policy Guide
* Organize and maintain the stockroom with the Operations Team
* Work closely with the Sales Associates, Visual Merchant and management team to maintain the sales area, including merchandise and the physical space
* Assist the Visual Merchant to support seasonal floor changes, as needed
* Inform the Operations Team and the Visual Merchant of the receipt of any new items, any overages or shortages of merchandise, and/or the condition of merchandise

**What you'll bring to the table...**


* Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to build rapport with customers and other associates
* General office equipment, including computer and printer, Zebra handheld devices, AS400 system, company email system, company learning management system, telephone/intercom system, copier, fax machine, SKU and tagger guns, tape machine, small hand tools, ladders, step stools, hand truck/dolly, baler, calculator, electronic two\-way radio with earpiece or Theatro communication system

**WHO WE ARE**

**Illinois Engineered Products – A Tradition of Engineering \& Manufacturing Since 1962**

In 1962, Don and Virginia Wynne founded Folding Guard® to manufacture quality steel products for safety, security, and storage applications. Building on more than 40 years of experience in the folding gate industry, their son, Dean Wynne, established **Illinois Engineered Products (IEP)** to focus on the design and manufacturing of heavy\-duty steel folding security gates.

Today, IEP manufactures heavy\-duty folding security gates in Chicago using U.S. steel. Our products serve dealers, distributors, contractors, industrial facilities, commercial properties, and other security\-focused applications throughout the United States.

**Manufacturing Excellence – Made in America**

IEP operates from a 50,000\-square\-foot Chicago manufacturing facility dedicated to folding gate production. We specialize in heavy\-duty galvanized steel folding gates and maintain an inventory of more than 1,000 gates.

In\-stock products typically ship within **2–3 business days**, while custom products generally ship within **7–14 business days**. Our experienced sales, engineering, and manufacturing teams work together to help customers select the right solution for both standard and custom applications.

PartsSource is the **leading technology and software platform for managing mission\-critical healthcare equipment**. Trusted by over 5,000 US hospitals and 15,000 clinical sites, PartsSource empowers providers and service organizations to maximize clinical availability for patient care and automates the procurement of parts, services and training through a unique digital experience.

  

PartsSource team members are deeply committed to our mission of **Ensuring Healthcare is Always On®**, which is foundational to our success and growth. Our vibrant culture is built upon aligned values, shared ownership, mutual respect, and a passion for collaborating to solve complex customer problems.



About the Job Opportunity



  

The Program Manager owns end\-to\-end delivery of PartsSource's largest and most complex customer programs across enterprise health systems, IDNs, and multi\-site organizations. You lead a matrixed project team spanning Engagement Managers, Implementation Specialists, technical resources, third\-party partners, and cross\-functional teams, holding them accountable to a comprehensive plan.



As the single accountable point of contact for customer executives, you own the integrated program: the cross\-functional workstream plan, dependencies between solutions and third\-party applications, the executive governance structure, and the change management that moves clinical and operational teams to full adoption. You sit in front of health system CFOs, COOs, and C\-suite sponsors, navigating complex environments and establishing trusted relationships at all organizational levels.



Your success is measured by whether the program drives the intended clinical and operational outcomes and by your ability to build and sustain customer relationships that span the entire implementation lifecycle.



What You'll Do

Build and maintain a single master program plan spanning every in\-scope workstream, with defined critical path, sequencing logic, and explicit dependency mapping. Determine the right implementation sequence and identify which workstreams gate others, where parallel execution is safe, and where phasing protects customer stability. Set the program\-level milestone framework and hold each workstream lead accountable to it, escalating slippage before it consumes float. Direct Engagement Managers, Implementation Specialists, and technical resources without formal authority, establishing clear ownership at the workstream level.

Own the master statement of work and its relationship to subordinate SOWs, service descriptions, joinders, and site\-level addenda. Present program scope, structure, assumptions, and dependencies to customer executives for alignment and sign\-off. Size total program effort across workstreams, surface resourcing gaps early, and negotiate capacity. Manage change at the program level by assessing downstream impact of every change request on other workstreams, cost, and go live.



Establish Executive Governance \& Stakeholder Relationships



Design and run the governance model including workstream sessions, program\-level integration cadences, and an executive Steering Committee at the C\-suite level. Produce reporting that consolidates multiple workstreams into a clear view of progress, risk, decisions, and value delivered. Serve as the single accountable point of contact for customer executive sponsors and escalation path for issues crossing workstream boundaries. Build and sustain relationships across HTM, supply chain, clinical engineering, IT, finance, and executive leadership.



Manage Program Risk, Integrations \& Third Parties



Maintain a program\-level risk register identifying risks that emerge from interaction between workstreams, and define mitigation plans with named owners. Coordinate data feeds, interfaces, asset migration, and ERP connections across technical teams and customer IT. Own relationships and delivery dates for OEMs, service providers, vendors, and multi\-party delivery structures. Sequence onsite activity across multiple facilities and geographies, including inventories, deployments, and go live support.



Drive Adoption \& Benefits Realization



Lead change management for multi\-solution implementations. Set measurable criteria for each workstream and program overall; validate adoption and confirm benefits realization before closure. Hold accountability for the program's Customer Onboarding Index (COI) result against the 85%\+ standard. Lead the In\-Market Support phase through a clean transition to Services and Customer Success. Run retrospectives and feed findings back into the implementation methodology.



Partner Across the Organization \& Advance the Practice
